Cult.NoWorship: No Worship — rituals give neither Faith nor dice.

Cult.NotePh: what they can do, what they fear
Cult.StasisWarn: No Faith: each day — minus a point of temporary Willpower; when Willpower runs out — oblivion.
Cult.StasisDrain: {name} without Faith: −{n} Willpower ({w} left). Without Faith they fade.
Cult.Stasis: {name}, without Faith or Willpower, falls into oblivion and dreams in the reliquary; only Faith will wake them.

Possess.Title: Possession
Possess.Hint: A worshipper or servant ready to die for the master touches the reliquary — a Faith roll. Failure — again next turn, botch — never this person. The body lives 48 chronicle hours; each point of Faith in the body — minus an hour.
Possess.WhoPh: a museum guard, a faithful priestess of the cult…
Possess.BannedWarn: The Earthbound can no longer possess this person ({name}).
Possess.Already: The Earthbound is already in a body: {name}.
Possess.Botch: {name} shatters {who}'s mind — they can never possess this body.
Possess.Fail: {name} couldn't hold {who}'s mind — again next turn.
Possess.Done: {name} enters {who}'s body: the body's Attributes and Abilities are theirs, the visage — by a Faith roll. The body will live {h} chronicle hours, each point of Faith in it — minus an hour.
Possess.LeftHint: 48 chronicle hours from possession; Faith spent in the body — {spent} h, extended — {ext} h
Possess.ExtendHint: A Faith roll: success — the body lives an hour longer
Possess.Extended: {who}'s body will hold out another hour — {h} h left.
Possess.LeaveConfirm: Leave the body early? The person will die at their hour anyway — the demon's power is already destroying them.
Possess.Died: {who}'s body can't bear the demon's power and perishes — burns, petrifies or crumbles to dust, by the primary Lore. {name} returns to the reliquary.
Possess.BattleHint: The body's time ran out mid-combat: a secret Stamina roll for the body, diff. 8 — how many turns it holds out; spending Faith in those turns — the body dies at once
Possess.BattleTurns: {who}'s body will hold out {n} more turn(s). Spending Faith or a Faith roll — it dies immediately.
Possess.BattleBotch: The sudden break from the body throws {name} off balance: −1 temporary Willpower.
Possess.LeftEarly: {name} leaves {who}'s body. The person is doomed: they'll die at their hour, and medicine won't help.

Host.BtnHint: The host body died: the Fallen manifests in apocalyptic form without a body and seeks a new host
Host.CardText: A Fallen without a host: can't harm or use Lores, sees souls, passes through walls — up to {miles} miles per turn. Each turn — a Willpower roll (diff. 6), otherwise the Abyss.
Host.Hunter: The host is a hunter who spent Conviction
Host.HunterHint: Hunter: The Reckoning, ch. 4 — a point of Conviction per scene makes a hunter immune to possession: the attempt fails without a roll.
Host.HunterRepels: {body} is a hunter with Second Sight: {name} beats against their will as against a wall and can't enter.
Host.LostZar: The body where {name} lived died after the Zar ritual — there is no new refuge, the Abyss takes them.
Host.AbyssText: The Abyss dragged the Fallen down. Only a summoning ritual can bring them back.
Host.Lost: {name}'s body perishes. Next turn they manifest in apocalyptic form, without a host: can't harm, can't use Lores, up to {miles} miles per turn. Each turn — a Willpower roll, diff. 6.
Host.LostExorcism: The exorcism casts {name} out of the body — they can't return to it. Without a host: up to {miles} miles per turn, each turn — a Willpower roll, diff. 6.
Host.HoldHow: Each bodiless turn — a Willpower roll ({n} dice, diff. 6) or a point of Willpower for a sure success (current Willpower: {w}). Failure — the Abyss.
Host.NoWill: No Willpower left — only the roll.
Host.Held: {name} clings to the world by force of will.
Host.Dragged: Hell's call is stronger: {name} is dragged into the Abyss. Only a summoning ritual can bring them back.
Host.Summoned: {name} is summoned from the Abyss and seeks a host.
Host.NewHint: A body is a living person with a fading soul, a thrall by pact, or an object people are drawn to. Once settled, the Fallen loses a point of permanent Faith and gains a point of permanent Torment.
Host.KindHuman: A person with a fading soul
Host.KindHumanHint: Coma, brain death, a mind almost gone — a Willpower roll, diff. 8.
Host.KindThrallHint: By pact — a Willpower roll, diff. 6; by the thrall's free will — no roll.
Host.KindObjectHint: A single thing people are drawn to (a statue, a manuscript, a writer's computer) — diff. 9, tied to the Fallen or their House — 6. The Fallen becomes Earthbound; botch — −1 permanent Willpower.
Host.Willing: The thrall lets them in willingly
Host.BodyPh: a nurse in a coma, a marble statue of a hero…
Host.Tied: The object is tied to the Fallen or their House (diff. 6)
Host.Fail: {name} couldn't hold the body ({body}) — searching further.
Host.FailObject: {name} couldn't inhabit the object ({body}); not this one a second time — searching further.
Host.NewBody: {name} possesses a new body — {body}. Losing the old one: −1 permanent Faith, +1 permanent Torment; the host's memories will feel alien for a long time.
Host.NewObject: {name} inhabits the object — {body} — and becomes Earthbound: −1 permanent Faith, +1 permanent Torment.
Host.NoLore: Without a body a Fallen can't use Lores.
Host.TurnTell: {name} is bodiless: holding on to the world — a Willpower roll, diff. 6 (the “Hold on” button on the Lores tab).

Gifts.BudgetHint: The thrall's Faith minus the master's share. Attributes — 2 dots per point, Abilities — up to 5 dots, an evocation — a point per circle, everything else — 1.
Gifts.NotePh: as the thrall asked: “lift five hundred pounds”
Gifts.UseEvocation: The thrall's Willpower roll, diff. 8; effect — by the master's Torment
Gifts.HighReason: a high-Torment gift on the thrall {name}
Gifts.HighTell: To the master ({master}) — 1 temporary Torment for a high-Torment trait on the thrall.
Gifts.EvocationHigh: {name} triggered a high-Torment effect — now it's a sin: a Virtue roll.
Gifts.Over: Not enough Faith for the gift: {used} needed, {total} available.
Gifts.NeedMaster: A master is needed — the Fallen the pact was made with.
Gifts.NothingFromMaster: The master has nothing of the kind (Visage, Lores or House).

Hint.innate: A Fallen's innate ability — 1 Faith; use — 1 Willpower per scene (soaking lethal — 2). Awareness — radius by the thrall's Faith.
Hint.form: A trait of the master's apocalyptic form — 1 Faith; use — 1 Willpower per scene. A high-Torment trait — also 1 temporary Torment to the master.
Hint.evocation: An evocation from the master's Lores — a point of Faith per circle. The thrall's Willpower roll, diff. 8; a high-Torment effect — then a sin for the thrall.
Hint.house: A special gift of the master's House — 1 Faith, no Willpower: always active. A custom gift — only for the thrall themselves, in the spirit of the House.
Hint.heal: Healing — 1 Faith for each injury or illness (paralysis, cancer, a derangement); 1 — immunity to disease and aging. If the pact breaks — the ailment returns.
Hint.attr: Attributes — 2 dots per point of Faith (up to 5). The bonus goes straight to the sheet; if the pact breaks — it's gone.
Hint.abil: Abilities — up to 5 dots per point of Faith (up to 5); from 4 — a specialty in the spirit of the pact. The bonus goes straight to the sheet.
Hint.other: A custom gift in words — the Storyteller sets the price.

Creator.DomitorClanHint: A vassal's “in-clan” Disciplines are the domitor's clan Disciplines: the second dot comes from them, experience × 15.
Creator.DonorGenHint: A ghoul's Discipline cap follows the donor's generation: 13–8 — 1, 7 — 2, 6 — 3, 5 — 4, 4 — 5.
Creator.DhStrongHint: At the Storyteller's option: Attributes 7/4/3, Abilities 12/8/4 and one more dot of the Antecedent's clan Discipline.
Creator.DhNoRightsHint: At the Storyteller's option: instead of a Bloodright — one more dot of tertiary Abilities.
Creator.DhNote: Dhampir: own blood (10 + Antiquity), Disciplines no higher than 1 until ghouled or Effluence 4+; experience: Antecedent's clan Discipline × 15, Bloodright — new 7, then × 5.
Creator.FamilyOnly: Revenant: the second Discipline dot must be a family one; “{name}” is not.

GhoulTypeHint.vassal: Serves a domitor and drinks their vitae: Disciplines from the master's clan. Virtues 7.
GhoulTypeHint.independent: A ghoul without a master who finds vitae alone. “In-clan” — Potence, Fortitude, Celerity.
GhoulTypeHint.revenant: A hereditary ghoul family that makes its own vitae: family Disciplines, family flaw, Virtues 5.
GhoulTypeHint.dhampir: A child of cursed blood (Accursed Heirs): own blood, Bloodrights, 18 freebies.

Creator.ChangelingHint: Kith — your fae nature (Realm affinity, Birthrights, Frailty); seeming — your mortal guise's age and a Temper bonus; court and two Legacies (Seelie and Unseelie, your court's is primary); House — optional. Threshold — what inspires your muse, Antithesis — your personal Banality trigger.
Creator.ConceptHintChangeling: Name, concept, Nature and Demeanor. A changeling is a fae spirit in a mortal body: think about who the mortal guise was before the Chrysalis and what in them answered the Dreaming.
Creator.DiscHintChangeling: 3 dots of Arts and 5 dots of Realms (ch. 3). A cantrip is an Art plus the target's Realm: Actor — people, Fae — fae and chimera, Nature — the living, Prop — things; Scene and Time are modifiers.
Creator.AdvHintChangeling: 5 dots of changeling Backgrounds: Chimera, Dreamers, Holdings, Remembrance, Title, Treasure and others.
Creator.FreeHintChangeling: 15 freebies: Attribute 5, Ability 2, Art 5, Realm 2, Background 1, Glamour 3, Willpower 1. Banality cannot be bought; Flaws up to 7 (from the book, as reference).
Creator.FinishHintChangeling: Check the Dreaming, Arts and Realms. Writing sets Glamour, Willpower and Banality by seeming; the Banality pool starts empty.

TierChangeling.fledglingHint: The awakening was recent — the Dreaming is still new.
TierChangeling.neonateHint: A few years at court: oaths, a freehold, first enemies.
TierChangeling.ancillaHint: Knows the price of Glamour and Banality, has walked the Near Dreaming.
TierChangeling.elderHint: Decades in the Dreaming are rare: the mortal guise ages, Banality builds.

Creator.WraithHint: Легион — по тому, как вы умерли; Гильдия — по Арканосу, которым вы владеете лучше всего (по желанию); фракция — Иерархия, Отступники, Еретики или Перевозчики.
Creator.PassionsHint: Страсти дают Пафос, Оковы — Волю и право оставаться в Землях Теней. По 10 очков, рейтинги 1–5.
Creator.ShadowHint: Тень — ваша тёмная половина. Архетип, бросок постоянного Ангста, 7 точек Тёмных Страстей и 10 свободных очков Тени (с торгом — больше или меньше).
Creator.ConceptHintWraith: Кем вы были, как умерли и почему ещё здесь. Натура — истинная личность (возвращает Волю), Маска — то, что видят другие.
Creator.DiscHintWraith: Арканои: {n} точек, не больше 3 в одном. Каждая точка даёт Общий уровень; Посвящённый уровень Гильдии — на листе, по Статусу.
Creator.AdvHintWraith: Фоны: {bg} точек — Мемориум (Пафос), Эйдолон (против Тени), Обиталище, Наследие, Реликвия, Артефакт, Статус в Гильдии…
Creator.FreeHintWraith: 15 свободных очков. Торг с Тенью: до 7 очков взаймы у неё — но и Тень станет сильнее.
Creator.FinishHintWraith: Проверьте призрака. Тень доведёт ведущий: точный счёт Ангста игроку Психеи знать не положено.
Creator.GateHintWraith: Легион и Гильдия, Арканои, Страсти и Оковы, Тень — мастер создания соберёт призрака по правилам Wraith 20.

Creator.LostNoConviction: A Bystander's Conviction is 10, it isn't bought.
Creator.VirtueHintLost: Seven dots among Courage, Reason and Self-Control, each from 1 to 5; with freebie points — 2 per dot.
Creator.ConceptHintLost: The Bystander saw a monster but didn't answer the Messengers. Who are they: family, work, friends, faith — everything they hold on to so as not to go mad.
Creator.AdvHintLost: Five dots of Backgrounds — without Destiny and Patron; Archive and Steel Nerves are available. Seven dots of Bystander Virtues.
Creator.FreeHintLost: 21 points: Attribute 5, Ability 2, Background 1, Willpower 1, Virtue 2. Conviction — 10, not bought.
Creator.FinishHintLost: Check the Virtues (each from 1). A Bystander's Conviction is 10, Willpower — 3 plus freebie points; no Edges.
Creator.HunterExtra: Experienced hunter: Virtue points beyond three

Creator.HunterConvWill: Starting Conviction no higher than Willpower.

Creator.HunterNoBuy: Hunter Virtues aren't bought, Conviction — only with freebie points (no higher than 8).

Creator.BloodrightReq: “{name}”: a dot of the “{d}” Discipline is needed.
Creator.BloodrightMax: “{name}”: there are never more than 3 dots.
Creator.DhSwap: An Antecedent clan Discipline instead of Potence
Creator.DhSwapHint: Accursed Heirs, ch. 3: a clan dhampir can, at creation, replace the free Potence dot with a dot of one of the Antecedent clan's Disciplines.
Creator.DhSwapNeedsClan: Potence is replaced — a dot of an Antecedent clan Discipline is needed.

Creator.FreeHintHunter: 21 points: Attribute 5, Ability 2, Background 1, Willpower 1, Conviction 1 (no higher than 8). Virtues and Edges aren't bought.
Creator.FinishHintHunter: Check the creed, Virtues and Edges. A hunter's Willpower — 3 plus freebie points; the imbued have no Humanity.

Creator.DarkFreeOnly: Dark Lores — only with freebie points (5 per dot) or experience.
Creator.WorshipNeedsCult: Worship is impossible without a Cult: Cult • at least is needed.

Creator.EarthboundOn: A King of Horror in a reliquary: Urges instead of Virtues, Faith accumulates from worship, evocations — high Torment only.
Creator.EarthboundOff: A Fallen long locked in an object or place and twisted by mortal worship (Earthbound, ch. 3). Usually — the Storyteller's antagonist.
Creator.EarthboundHint: Create an Earthbound: Attributes 8/6/4, Abilities 17/12/7, Backgrounds 10, Lores 10, Urges instead of Virtues, Faith 4, Torment 10, 21 freebie points
Creator.NeedVisage: Choose a Visage — the main Lore by which the Fallen assumes apocalyptic form.
Creator.OnlyHouse: At the start, Lores — only of your own House and common ones (Fundament, Humanity); others — with experience.
Creator.HouseHint: House is the Fallen's celestial calling: three House Lores and starting Torment. Visage is the main Lore, the apocalyptic form comes from it. Faction — optional.
Creator.ConceptHintDemon: Who the mortal host was and what the Fallen remembers about themselves. Nature restores Willpower. Starting experience — the Storyteller's call.
Creator.DiscHintDemon: Dots: {n} — into your House's Lores and the common ones (Fundament, Humanity). You can see which evocations each dot opens.
Creator.AdvHintDemon: Check Backgrounds and distribute {bg} dots; Virtues — a dot in each and {virt} more. Willpower = the sum of the two highest Virtues.
Creator.DiscHintEarthbound: Dots: {n} — into your House's Lores and the common ones. Dark Lores (Chaos, Contamination, Violence) — only with freebie points (5 per dot) or experience.
Creator.AdvHintEarthbound: Distribute {bg} Background dots — the Earthbound's own Backgrounds (Cult, Worship, Hoard…); no Contacts, Followers, Mentor, Pacts or Legacy. Urges — a dot in each and {virt} more. Willpower = the sum of the two highest Urges.
Creator.FreeHintEarthbound: 21 freebie points at Earthbound prices: Attribute 6, Ability 2, Lore 5, Background 1, Faith 5, Urge 3, Willpower 1. Right-click — remove a point.
Creator.PactTermsPh: what the thrall must do and what the master doesn't demand
Creator.PactWordsPh: “so that no one dares touch me again”, “heal my sister”…
Creator.PactBoostsHint: Attributes — 2 dots per point of Faith, Abilities — up to 5 dots per point; no higher than 5. Other gifts (healing, innate, form traits, evocations, special House gifts) — in words above and with points per chapter 14.
Creator.PactNoMaster: No Fallen master chosen: the pact won't be written to their sheet.
Creator.PactOver: The gifts exceed the thrall's Faith by {n}.
Creator.PactNoPoints: No more Faith points for gifts.
Creator.PactNoAccess: The pact isn't written to the sheet “{name}” — no permission; ask the Storyteller to add the thrall on the master's “Advantages” tab.
Creator.ThrallOn: A mortal who made a pact with a Fallen (Damned and Deceived, ch. 4): Fallen Virtues, thrall's Faith, last step — the pact and gifts.
Creator.ThrallOff: If the mortal made a deal with a demon — create them as a thrall: their own numbers, Fallen Backgrounds and the “Dance with the Devil” step.
Creator.ConceptHintThrall: The person as they were before the pact: the flaw for which they made the deal should be visible. Nature and Demeanor — any (new ones: Damned Soul, Narcissist, Preacher).
Creator.AdvHintThrall: Check Backgrounds and distribute {bg} dots (no Eminence, Legacy, Pacts, Paragon; Caring Master and Initiation are available). Virtues — a dot each and {virt} more. Willpower = the sum of the two highest Virtues.
Creator.FreeHintThrall: Fifteen freebie points: Attribute 5, Ability 2 (now up to 5), Background 1, Virtue 2, Willpower 1, thrall's Faith 7. Right-click — remove a point.
Creator.PactHint: A pact with a Fallen: choose a master, decide how much of the thrall's Faith goes to them (no more than half, rounded up) — the rest goes to gifts. The thrall asks in words, and the price is in Faith points: Attributes 2 dots for 1, Abilities up to 5 dots for 1.
Creator.FinishHintThrall: Thrall's Faith — 1 (plus freebie points), Torment 0, Willpower — the sum of the two highest Virtues. The thrall's sin is counted by their permanent Willpower. The pact is also written to the master's sheet.
Creator.FinishHintEarthbound: Faith — 4 (plus freebie points), Torment — 10 forever, Willpower — the sum of the two highest Urges, reliquary — as chosen at the House step. Lores are written to the sheet along with evocations.
Creator.FreeHintDemon: Fifteen freebie points at Demon: The Fallen prices. Right-click — remove a point.
Creator.FinishHintDemon: Faith — 3 (plus freebie points), Torment — by House, Willpower — the sum of the two highest Virtues. Lores are written to the sheet along with evocations.
Creator.FactionHint: A faction is optional: you can stay apart from all of them.
Creator.FreeCostsDemon: Prices: Attribute {attr}, Ability {abil}, Lore {disc}, Background {bg}, Virtue {virt}, Faith {mor}, Willpower {will}. Right-click — remove.
Creator.XpCostsDemon: Experience per ch. 6: new Lore 7 (other House 10), Lore × 5, Faith × 7. The next dot's price is in the “+” tooltip.
Creator.XpMortal: Experience beyond creation, if the Storyteller gives it — enter a number.
Creator.XpDemon: The Fallen have no age in the Blood: experience beyond creation, if the Storyteller gives it — enter a number.
Creator.GateHintMortal: The wizard walks you through V20 mortal rules: concept, Attributes 6/4/3, Abilities 11/7/4, Backgrounds, Virtues, Merits and freebie points — with hints and point tallies. A mortal can be created as a Fallen's thrall right away.
Creator.GateHintGhoul: The wizard walks you through V20 ghoul rules: concept and domitor, Attributes 6/4/3, Abilities 11/7/4, Disciplines (Potence — from the start), Backgrounds, Virtues, Merits and freebie points — with hints and point tallies.
Creator.GateHintDemon: The wizard walks you through Demon: The Fallen rules: concept, House and Visage, Attributes 7/5/3, Abilities 13/9/5, Lores, Backgrounds, Virtues, Merits and freebie points — with hints and tallies.
Creator.OnlyClan: At the start, Disciplines — only clan ones; others — with freebie points.

SectRule.camarilla: Camarilla (Guide to the Camarilla): out-of-clan {list} are unavailable to a Camarilla vampire.
SectRule.sabbat: Sabbat (Guide to the Sabbat): 4 dots of clan Disciplines (panders — any), no starting Backgrounds — only with freebie points with the Storyteller's permission, Virtues 5. Vinculum to the pack — after creation, with the “To the pack” button on the advantages tab.
SectRule.anarchs: Anarchs (V20 Anarchs Unbound): numbers as in V20; their own Backgrounds, archetypes (Anarchist, Critic, Nihilist) and traits — marked “Anarchs”.

Creator.SectBanned: {name}: an out-of-clan Discipline unavailable to a Camarilla vampire (Guide to the Camarilla).
Creator.SectReset: The sect's numbers differ — the distribution was reset: {what}.
Creator.SabbatNoBg: The Sabbat has no starting Backgrounds — their dots only with freebie points.
Creator.HasProblems: Some items are still open. Save the character anyway?
Creator.MalkDerangementHint: Malkavian weakness: choose a derangement together with the Storyteller.
Creator.ConceptHint: Who the character was before the Embrace and who they became. Nature restores Willpower; age in the Blood grants experience beyond creation.
Creator.ConceptHintGhoul: Who the character was before the first taste of vitae and whom they serve. Nature restores Willpower; length of service grants experience beyond creation.
Creator.ConceptPh: a Jacobin, a seamstress, a former abbot…
Creator.PathRules: At the start a Path is no higher than 5, Willpower no lower than 5, inhuman Virtues start at 0
Creator.AttrHint: Choose the group priority ({a} / {b} / {c}) and distribute dots. Each Attribute already has one dot.
Creator.AbilHint: Group priority ({a} / {b} / {c}); no higher than 3 at this step.
Creator.GhoulDisc: Potence 1 — free; one more dot of any Discipline.
Creator.GenerationHint: The “Generation” Background: each dot — one generation older than the 13th.
Creator.VirtueHint: Conscience and Self-Control start at 1 (on Paths — 0), Courage — at 1.
Creator.MeritHint: Merits cost freebie points, Flaws give them — no more than 7.
Creator.FreeCosts: Prices: Attribute {attr}, Ability {abil}, Discipline {disc}, Background {bg}, Virtue {virt}, morality {mor}, Willpower {will}. Right-click — remove.
Creator.FinishHint: Humanity = Conscience + Self-Control, Willpower = Courage (including freebie points). Blood pool — a 1d10 roll; without the roll — half the maximum.
Creator.FinishHintGhoul: Humanity = Conscience + Self-Control, Willpower = Courage (including freebie points). The ghoul's vitae pool is set by the domitor: usually 1 active point of 2 (V20, ch. 7).
Creator.AllGood: Everything is distributed — ready to save.

TierWraith.fledglingHint: Только что умер и очнулся в Землях Теней: создание по книге, без опыта.
TierWraith.neonateHint: Несколько лет среди мёртвых, знает Гильдию и Легион.
TierWraith.ancillaHint: Десятилетия в Стигии, пережитые Мальстрёмы и Испытания.
TierWraith.elderHint: Век и больше за Покровом, помнит прежние Мальстрёмы.

TierWerewolf.fledglingHint: Только что прошёл Первую перемену: создание по книге, без опыта.
TierWerewolf.neonateHint: Несколько лет в стае, первые победы.
TierWerewolf.ancillaHint: Годы войны с Вирмом, имя в песнях племени.

TierHunter.fledglingHint: Только что услышал Посланников: создание по книге, без опыта.
TierHunter.neonateHint: Месяцы охоты, ячейка и первые потери.
TierHunter.elderHint: Пережил столько, сколько мало кто из Призванных.

TierDemon.fledglingHint: Только что вырвался из Бездны в тело: создание по книге, без опыта.
TierDemon.neonateHint: Несколько лет в мире людей, первые слуги.
TierDemon.ancillaHint: Годы интриг среди падших и смертных.
TierDemon.elderHint: Давно на Земле, сеть слуг и врагов.

TierMortal.fledglingHint: Только что столкнулся с Миром Тьмы: создание по книге, без опыта.
TierMortal.ancillaHint: Десятилетия среди чудовищ и их тайн.

TierGhoulFree.fledglingHint: The master died or left recently — vitae must be found alone.
TierGhoulFree.neonateHint: A few years alone: knows where and from whom to get blood.
TierGhoulFree.ancillaHint: Decades without a bond, contacts and debts among the Kindred.
TierGhoulFree.elderHint: A century or more on stolen blood, outlived those who hunted them.

TierRevenant.fledglingHint: A young family member, just learning its ways.
TierRevenant.neonateHint: A few years serving the family and its masters.
TierRevenant.ancillaHint: Decades in the family, its secrets and duties.
TierRevenant.elderHint: A century or more — a revenant ages slowly, their blood pool grows.

TierDhampir.fledglingHint: Just learned of their blood: creation by the book, no experience.
TierDhampir.neonateHint: A few years learning to live with the Bloodrights.
TierDhampir.ancillaHint: Decades among Kindred and hunters, a place in their world.
TierDhampir.elderHint: A century or more — the Antecedent's blood keeps them longer than mortals.

TierGhoul.fledglingHint: Just tasted vitae: creation by the book, no experience.
TierGhoul.ancillaHint: Decades of service, the domitor's secrets: +120 experience.
TierGhoul.elderHint: A century or more on blood, outlived former masters: +300 experience.

Tier.fledglingHint: Just Embraced: creation by the book, no experience.
Tier.ancillaHint: Decades in the Blood, connections and enemies: +120 experience.
Tier.elderHint: A century or more, a player of the Jyhad: +300 experience.

Creator.ClanHint: The clan determines clan Disciplines and weakness. Generation is bought with the “Generation” Background.
Creator.AttrHintShort: Set group priorities and distribute dots. Each Attribute already has one dot.
Creator.AbilHintShort: Group priorities; no higher than 3 at this step. The rest — with freebie points and experience.
Creator.DiscHint: Dots: {n} — only into clan Disciplines (Caitiff and panders — any). You can see which powers each dot opens.
Creator.DiscHintGhoul: A ghoul has Potence 1 free and one more dot of a Discipline the domitor has (usually a clan one). You can see which powers each dot opens (V20, ch. 7).
Creator.AdvHint: Check Backgrounds and distribute {bg} dots; Virtues — {virt} dots.
Creator.AdvHintNoBg: No starting Backgrounds — check the ones you need and buy dots at the freebie step; Virtues — {virt} dots.
Creator.FreeHint: Freebie points at book prices. Right-click — remove a point.
Creator.XpHint: Experience beyond creation by the V20 table: new Ability 3, Attribute ×4, clan Discipline ×5…
Creator.GenTip: Blood pool {pool}, per turn {turn}; costs {cost} dots of “Generation”
Creator.PathedNote: Powers come in paths: the primary path will appear on the sheet.
Creator.XpCosts: The next dot's price is in the “+” tooltip. Backgrounds can't be bought with experience.
Creator.TraitBlocked: “{a}” is incompatible with “{b}” — as the trait's text says.
Creator.TraitCamarillaOnly: “{name}” is meant for the Camarilla — check with the Storyteller.
Creator.GateHintWerewolf: Breed, auspice and tribe, three Gifts, Rage and Gnosis — the wizard builds the Garou by W20 rules.

Mark.lead: не обычный человек? — выберите, кто он
Mark.title: Unusual mortal
Mark.none: An ordinary human — or Garou Kinfolk, Kami, fomor.
Mark.kinfolkHint: Kinfolk: immune to the Delirium; Gifts and numina are bought with experience on the sheet.
Mark.kamiHint: Kami: Willpower, Gnosis and Rage by form; the Destiny Background at least 1.
Mark.fomorHint: Fomor: breed powers are given automatically; Humanity drops with every power.
Mark.fomorPick: Breed powers are marked; pick up to two more.
Mark.sorcererHint: Sorcerer: Willpower 5, 5 dots of Paths or phenomena (taken on the sheet), 21 freebies. No Paradox.
Mark.consorHint: Consor (Gods & Monsters): a mage's companion — Willpower 3, at least a dot in Mentor, 21 freebies (15 for an acolyte).

Creator.GarouHint: Kind: Garou or one of the Changing Breeds. Garou pick a breed (Gnosis), an auspice (Rage and Renown) and a tribe (Willpower, totem, Background limits); Fera choose within their breed. A metis needs a deformity.
Creator.GiftsHint: Three level-1 Gifts: one each from the breed, auspice and tribe lists. Fera — one per slot of their breed (Mokolé and Rokea have two). More of your own level-1 Gifts cost freebies.
Creator.ConceptHintGarou: Who the character was before the First Change and who they became. Nature restores Willpower.
Creator.AbilHintShortGarou: 13 / 9 / 5 by group; no higher than 3 at start — above that only with freebies. Lupus cannot take Crafts, Drive, Etiquette, Firearms, Larceny and some Knowledges with starting points.
Creator.AdvHintGarou: 5 Background dots (the tribe sets limits). On the right — Renown: by auspice; Ragabash and Fera split 3 dots freely.
Creator.FreeHintGarou: 15 freebies; Flaws add up to 7. Gifts beyond three are already counted (7 each).
Creator.XpHintGarou: Experience beyond creation: Attribute — current × 4, Ability — 3 for the first, then current × 2, Rage — current, Gnosis — current × 2, Willpower — current.
Creator.FinishHintGarou: Review the Garou. Rank 1, breed form; Gifts, Renown, Rage and Gnosis are written to the sheet.
Creator.GarouExtra: Gifts beyond the starting ones — {n} freebies each
Creator.GarouBaseHint: Rage comes from the auspice, Gnosis from the breed, Willpower from the tribe (Fera — from the choice within the breed). Raise them with freebies.
Creator.FreeCostsGarou: W20 costs: Attribute 5, Ability 2, Background 1 (raises Backgrounds taken on the Backgrounds step), Gift 7, Rage 1, Gnosis 2, Willpower 1. Right-click to remove.
Creator.XpCostsGarou: W20 costs: Attribute — current × 4, Ability — new 3, then current × 2, Rage — current, Gnosis — current × 2, Willpower — current.
Creator.GarouExtraAfter: Pick the starting Gifts above first — then the rest of your own Level One Gifts appear here.
Creator.AddDiscHint: Out-of-clan Discipline: starting dots go only to clan Disciplines; this one is raised with freebie points (7 per dot) or experience (new — 10, then current × 7).
Creator.ExtraDiscHint: Additional Discipline Merit: the chosen Discipline counts as a clan Discipline — for starting dots and experience cost (current × 5). Choice requires the Storyteller's approval.
Creator.ExtraDiscNeed: Additional Discipline Merit: choose which Discipline becomes a clan Discipline.
Creator.ExtraDiscCaitiff: Caitiff and panders cannot take the Additional Discipline Merit.
Creator.InitialOutOfClan: {name}: starting Discipline dots go only to clan Disciplines; raise an out-of-clan one with freebie points or experience.
Creator.MageHint: Faction — a Tradition, a Technocratic Convention or a Craft; the Avatar's Essence; one affinity Sphere (from the faction's list). Below is the focus: what the mage believes and how they work magick.
Creator.DiscHintMage: Spheres: {n} dots. One must go to the affinity Sphere. No Sphere may exceed Arete (1 at creation, up to 3 with freebies).
Creator.AdvHintMage: Backgrounds: {bg} dots. Avatar sets starting Quintessence. Mages have no Virtues — on the right is what they start with.
Creator.FreeHintMage: 15 freebie points: Attribute 5, Ability 2, Background 1, Sphere 7, Arete 4 (up to 3), Willpower 1. Raise Arete if the Spheres need room.

TierMage.fledglingHint: Newly Awakened: by-the-book creation, no experience.
TierMage.neonateHint: A few years of study under a mentor: +35 experience.
TierMage.ancillaHint: Decades of the Art, enemies and debts of one's own: +120 experience.
TierMage.elderHint: A century on the Path, a name in the Tradition's chronicles: +300 experience.

Creator.GateHintChangeling: There is no changeling creation wizard yet: fill the sheet by hand — Attributes 7/5/3, Abilities 13/9/5, Backgrounds 5, Arts 3, Realms 5, Willpower 4, Glamour 4, Banality 3 plus the seeming bonus, 15 freebies (C20, ch. 3).

MonthlyIncome.Name: Monthly income from Resources
MonthlyIncome.Hint: When the chronicle month changes, player characters with “Resources” get income into their purse, as a single chat card.

IncomeTable.Name: Income from Resources by dots
IncomeTable.Hint: Five monthly amounts separated by “/” in the chronicle's currency, for 1–5 dots. Empty — the default: $500/1200/3000/9000/30000, 25/100/400/1500/6000 livres in 1789.

HerdNightly.Name: Blood from Herd every night
HerdNightly.Hint: With the “Night” button a vampire with Herd gets as much blood as Herd dots (system rule). Unchecked, Herd, as in the book, only adds dice to hunting.

UiSounds.Name: Interface sounds
UiSounds.Hint: A button click, a drip and a heartbeat when spending blood, a thud on damage, a success bell and a failure tone after a roll. Only for you; volume follows Foundry's “Interface”.

UiSoundVolume.Name: Interface sound volume
UiSoundVolume.Hint: A share of the “Interface” volume in Foundry's sound settings.

DarkAges.Name: Dark Ages content
DarkAges.Hint: Show Dark Ages paths, rituals, Merits and Flaws in the creation wizard, library and on the sheet. Independent of the chronicle's era.

Era.Name: Chronicle era
Era.Hint: Changes three Abilities: Drive → Ride, Computer → Theology, Technology → Warfare (system rule).

NightlyWillpower.Name: Willpower on awakening
NightlyWillpower.Hint: The “Awakening” button restores 1 point of Willpower.

DawnWarnings.Name: Dawn warnings
DawnWarnings.Hint: 30 minutes before sunrise and at sunrise — a chat card and a bell for everyone (by the night clock).

UiSkin.Name: “Masquerade” interface skin
UiSkin.Hint: Parchment, cockades and night blue for the sidebar and chat.

ExorcismRule.Name: Exorcism system
ExorcismRule.Hint: How mortals cast the Fallen out of bodies. “Saviors and Destroyers” — finding the host's soul, then hour by hour Willpower against Willpower; victory sends the spirit to the Abyss. “Core book” — Faith against Willpower once an hour, more victories than the demon's permanent Faith; the cast-out one seeks a new body.

HunterGrowth.Name: Hunter: growth of Virtues and Edges
HunterGrowth.Hint: “By the book” — a Virtue grows for 10 Conviction, Edges are granted by Virtue points. “By deeds” — the Storyteller rewards actions with temporary Virtue points, 10 temporary — a permanent point, Conviction isn't traded for Virtues. “By experience” — experience buys starting Conviction (new × 5, no higher than Willpower), the primary Virtue (new × 3), others (new × 5), Edges of the creed's path (level × 5) and other paths (level × 7); the Virtue only limits the highest Edge level, there's no 10-Conviction trade.

HunterSacrifice.Name: Hunter: Sacrifice
HunterSacrifice.Hint: Players Guide, ch. 2: the hunter gives up a dot of an Attribute (former × 3 advancement points), Ability (× 2) or Background (× 1), each trait once per story. Advancement points raise Virtues (primary — new × 2, others — × 3), 10 each lift a level five Edge condition; derangements — from Virtue 9, not 7.

HunterFreeform.Name: Hunter: Edges “from above”
HunterFreeform.Hint: Players Guide, ch. 2: the hunter has no Edges of their own. A point of Conviction and a Virtue roll (diff. 6) — an Edge for the scene no higher than the successes (the Storyteller may substitute). Failure — not again this scene, botch — not again this session. The sum of levels per story no more than the Virtue. Reset by the “End of scene” and “End of story” buttons.

HunterEdgeCost.Name: Hunter: Edge cost
HunterEdgeCost.Hint: How many Virtue points an Edge level costs. “By the book” — 1/2/3/4: 10 points take a path up to level IV. “Simplified” — 1/1/2/2/4: 10 points — up to V, and Edges come sooner (Zeal 4 — already level III).

HunterFifth.Name: Hunter: level five Edges
HunterFifth.Hint: Players Guide, ch. 2: a hunter with a Virtue of 10 can accept one level five Edge. The price — Willpower −5, Nature and Demeanor — Autocrat, Fanatic or Perfectionist, the other Virtues freeze, Patron 5, a frightening presence and once per story — an imposed creed decision.

TormentRule.Name: High-Torment evocations
TormentRule.Hint: How the high-Torment effect of Fallen evocations is decided. “Torment die” — a separate die against permanent Torment. “Majority of successes” — Demon Players Guide errata: ones cancel the highest successes, the majority among the rest decides, a tie — the normal effect.

PauseLook.Name: Pause look
PauseLook.Hint: “Drop” — a drop of blood freezes mid-fall, the world fades; on unpause it falls into a puddle. “Foundry default” — the usual caption.

NexusNav.Name: Scene nexus instead of the navigation bar
NexusNav.Hint: Enabled: Foundry's scene strip is hidden, replaced by a plate with the nexus button, scene name and night clock.

Latitude.Name: Chronicle city latitude
Latitude.Hint: Sunset and sunrise are computed from it. Paris 48.86, Lyon 45.76, Marseille 43.30, London 51.51.

Longitude.Name: Chronicle city longitude
Longitude.Hint: Together with the time zone it shifts noon, and with it sunset and sunrise. Paris 2.35, Lyon 4.84, London −0.13.

UtcOffset.Name: City time zone (UTC±)
UtcOffset.Hint: Local time offset from UTC in hours: Paris 1 (local solar time of 1789 ≈ 0.16), London 0.

Currency.Name: Chronicle currency
Currency.Hint: What characters' purses count in. “By era” — livres in 1789, dollars in modern nights; a character can have their own.

AssignatRate.Name: Assignat rate
AssignatRate.Hint: What percent of face value paper assignats fetch in coin right now. The books give no rate — the Storyteller changes it as the chronicle goes.

HuntersAlert.Name: Hunters on Masquerade Exposure
HuntersAlert.Hint: When the city's Masquerade heat reaches exposure, the Storyteller gets a card at nightfall: assemble a hunter cell, place a mark or dismiss it.

InitEachTurn.Name: Initiative every turn
InitEachTurn.Hint: At the start of each combat turn everyone rolls initiative again (1d10 + Dexterity + Wits − wounds), as in V20; one card with the order.

InitFixed.Name: Quick initiative without a roll
InitFixed.Hint: 6 instead of the die: initiative = 6 + Dexterity + Wits (quick variant of the rules).

Declare.Name: Declaration phase
Declare.Hint: After initiative, fighters declare actions from lowest initiative to highest; those delaying act at the end of the turn; defending without a declaration means aborting an action (Willpower).

MageWeekly.Name: Mages: weekly tick
MageWeekly.Hint: As the chronicle clock runs, once a week a cabal's Node yields into the chantry stock, and a mage with Paradox below 5 who cast nothing for a week sheds a point of Paradox.

Nexus.Title: Scene nexus
Nexus.TokenMissing: Token not found on the source scene.
Nexus.AlreadyHere: The token is already on this scene.
Nexus.SelectToken: Select a token on the current scene first.
Nexus.ClosedByGM: The Storyteller has closed this passage.
Nexus.NoGM: No active Storyteller — moving is impossible.
Nexus.NoAccess: The Storyteller hasn't opened access to this scene.
Nexus.DeleteGroupConfirm: Delete the district “{name}”? The scenes stay — only the grouping is deleted.
Nexus.DeleteSubConfirm: Delete the subgroup? Its scenes return to the district's general list.
Nexus.EntryOpenScene: Open this scene and select a token to set the entry point.
Nexus.EntrySelectToken: Select one token — its position becomes the entry point.
Nexus.SelectHint: Select a token on the scene, then click a passage card
Nexus.AddToSub: Add a scene to the subgroup…
Nexus.AddToGroup: Add a scene to the district…
Nexus.AddSubHint: Create a subgroup inside the district
Nexus.NoGroupsGM: No districts yet. Click “District”, add scenes to it and open passages — only open passages are visible to players.
Nexus.NoGroups: The Storyteller hasn't opened any passages yet.
Nexus.PeekHint: View the scene without moving the token
Nexus.ToggleOpen: Open or close the passage for players
Nexus.SetEntry: Entry point = selected token (on this scene)

Calendar.DawnSoonText: Time for the Kindred to go to their havens. Those caught by the sun face Rötschreck and aggravated damage.
Calendar.DawnRiseText: The sun rises over the city. Whoever isn't sheltered takes sunlight damage every turn (the “Hazard” window).
Calendar.Title: Night clock
Calendar.FlowHint: The clock runs by itself and the same for everyone: the world stores a reference point, not “what time it is now”.
Calendar.SceneHint: No mark. Set it at the start of a scene — the counter will appear in the nexus bar too.
Calendar.ChronicleHereHint: Count night numbers from the current date
Calendar.SmoothHint: Smooth: the clock speeds up and reaches the moment in a few seconds — characters on the map move before your eyes. Jump — instantly.

Combat.DamagePlus: +1 die for each attack success beyond the first
Combat.FoesHint: Outnumbered: +1 to attack and defense difficulty for each melee opponent after the first, no more than +4.
Combat.BlindRanged: An accurate blind ranged attack is impossible.
Combat.AutoHit: The target is fully immobilized — the attack hits automatically.

Target.helplessNote: A bound, staked or paralyzed target is struck without a roll to hit.
Target.label: Target

Rule.discipline: A new Discipline — 10 XP (for a ghoul — 20), clan ones are highlighted. The first dot opens a level I power; for Thaumaturgy and Necromancy the primary path is chosen right away.
Rule.path: The first path is primary: it grows with the Discipline. A secondary path — 7 XP, its rating no higher than the primary.
Rule.ritual: A ritual's level — no higher than the Discipline's dots. Rituals are obtained through the story — from a mentor or a grimoire — they aren't bought with experience.
Rule.combo: A combination power requires all listed Disciplines at the needed level and a mentor who knows it. The experience cost — by the book (V20 Lore of the Clans and others).
Rule.merit: Merits are taken at creation with freebie points; later — only with the Storyteller's permission.
Rule.flaw: Flaws give freebie points only at creation (no more than 7); later the Storyteller assigns them through the story.
Rule.background: Backgrounds grow through the story and with the Storyteller's permission; dots are chosen with the buttons.
Rule.derangement: A derangement appears over the course of the chronicle — from losing Humanity, Dementation or horror.
Rule.investment: An Investment is a separate deal with a demon: 3 XP (V20, no more than permanent Willpower), sealed with an atrocity and a Humanity roll. Older Investments from the Sabbat books — the Storyteller sets the price. Details — “V20 rules”, chapter 9.
Rule.edge: An Edge costs points of its Virtue by level; path levels — in order; Edges of other paths no higher than the highest Edge of the creed's path. Not bought with experience — they grow with Virtues (Hunter: The Reckoning, ch. 4–5).
Rule.pact: A ready-made pact is a preset: “Take” opens a pact with the gift, price and Devil’s Due rating filled in; enter the demon and the atrocity yourself. The numbers are a guide, the Storyteller adjusts them to the chronicle (reference, sections 9 and 15).
Rule.gift: A Gift no higher than Rank. Your Gifts — from your breed, auspice and tribe lists; others are taught by a spirit through the story (W20, ch. 4). XP: own — level × 3, other — level × 5.
Rule.rite: A rite no higher than the Rituals Ability. Taught by elder Garou and spirits (W20, ch. 4).
Rule.fetish: A fetish is attuned with Gnosis (W20, ch. 4). “Craft” uses the Rite of the Fetish for fetishes and the Rite of Binding for talens. Talens can be taken several times.
Rule.scar: A battle scar grants temporary Glory (W20, ch. 6); the same scar can be gained several times.
Rule.deform: Metis deformities are inborn: every metis has at least one (W20, ch. 1).
Rule.kinGift: Own: Kinfolk Gifts of your tribe and level-1 Garou Gifts of your tribe and breed — 15 XP. Other tribes’ Kinfolk Gifts — 20 (W20 Kinfolk).
Rule.numen: Kinfolk numina (W20 Kinfolk, ch. 3): at creation the first costs 7 per dot, the second 14; later — with experience. Set dots on the sheet.
Rule.kamiPower: A new Kami power costs (number of powers × 3) XP; immobile powers are for plants and land only (W20 Umbra, ch. 4).
Rule.fomorPower: Fomor powers come from the breed and the Wyrm’s possession (W20, ch. 13; Book of the Wyrm); repeatable ones are added again with the sheet button.
Rule.charm: General Charms belong to every spirit; special ones follow the template and the Storyteller (W20, ch. 9).
Rule.spiritTpl: A template sets the spirit’s traits, Essence and Charms; the description is whispered to the Storyteller.
Rule.arcanos: A new Arcanos costs 7 XP (6 for a Spectre), then current × 3. Initiate levels need Guild Status (Wraith 20, ch. 4, 8).
Rule.darkArcanos: A Spectre’s Dark Arcanoi (Wraith 20, ch. 10); every Spectre has Collogue.
Rule.risenArt: Fascinate and Serendipity — the Risen Arcanoi (Wraith 20, ch. 11).
Rule.realmArt: Arcanoi of your Dark Kingdom; a new one costs 7 XP, then current × 3.
Rule.thorn: Thorns are bought with the Shadow’s points at creation; a Thorn can be taken several times, each with its own note (Wraith 20, ch. 7).
Rule.frond: A Spectre’s Psyche Fronds (Wraith 20, ch. 10); cost is on the card.
Rule.shade: A Spectre’s Shadecraft (Wraith 20, ch. 10); use costs Angst.
Rule.stain: Orpheus projector Stains: each has an advantage and a drawback; how many you can carry depends on the Shade.
Rule.art: A new Art costs 7 XP, then current × 4 (C20).
Rule.rede: Lykeian Redes are paid with Rede points; the cost is on the card (C20 Players Guide).
Rule.cantrip: A cantrip can’t exceed the Dominion’s dots; cantrips per Dominion — no more than permanent Weaving (Dark Ages: Fae).
Rule.bloodright: A Bloodright needs its base Discipline; a new one costs 7 XP, or the Storyteller grants it (Accursed Heirs: Dhampirs).
Rule.sorcPath: A new Path costs 7 XP (21 if the sorcerer so far has only phenomena), then current × 7 (M20 Sorcerer).
Rule.sorcPsychic: A new phenomenon costs 7 XP (21 if the sorcerer so far has only Paths), then current × 7; rating up to half Willpower.
Rule.lore: A new Lore of your House or a common one costs 7 XP, another House’s or a Dark Lore — 10; Earthbound pay 6 and 8 (Demon: The Fallen, ch. 6).
Rule.rote: A book rote is recorded as coincidental — edit its kind and text afterwards. Fallen rotes are shown to Nephandi only.
Rule.weapon: A ready weapon is added with all its numbers; edit it afterwards if needed.
Rule.armor: Ready armor is added with its rating and penalty; edit it afterwards if needed.
Rule.gear: Ready gear is added with its description; adjust the quantity on the sheet.

City.ZoneHint: Click the vertices. Double-click or Enter — close, Esc — cancel.

City.LoadError: The map didn't load — an internet connection is needed. Details in the console (F12).

City.LangHint: Language of place names: Russian or French.
City.SettingHint: A pull-down blind with the chronicle's city map at the top edge of the screen.

Travel.PlaceTip: Place on the map: drag onto the plan or click here, then on the spot.

City.DomainMade: {name}: domain created and linked to the map.

Magic.RitualTooHigh: “{name}”: requires the “{d}” Discipline at level {l} or higher, the character has {n}.
Magic.SecondaryCap: “{name}”: a secondary path no higher than {n} — it's always below the primary (“{main}”), and reaches 5 only after the primary.
Magic.CounterNotPrimary: Thaumaturgical Countermagic can't be the primary path.
Magic.LostWill: {name} loses a point of Willpower — the magic backfired.
Magic.LostWillPermanent: {name} loses a dot of permanent Willpower — the magic turned against the caster.

magic.failed: The magic didn't work. The blood was spent in vain.
magic.botch: Botched magic: trouble up to catastrophe — loss of Willpower or even a Willpower dot, spontaneous combustion, the power slips out of control. The Storyteller decides.

ritual.failed: The ritual failed: strange side effects — or the Storyteller pretends it worked and reveals it at the worst moment.
ritual.botch: Botched ritual: a catastrophe, up to summoning enraged demons. The Storyteller decides.

GhoulLife.Title: Vitae
GhoulLife.Calm: Vitae is fine: no withdrawal, no taint.
GhoulLife.Hint: A ghoul lives on borrowed blood: more than 4 points in a row from one clan — Stamina (diff 5); beyond the pool — one extra point per Stamina dot; without vitae — withdrawal for (6 − Stamina) weeks, Disciplines fade after 6 months. "Without vitae" counts from the night the pool ran dry.
GhoulLife.HintRevenant: A revenant makes its own vitae — no withdrawal or Discipline loss; overdose and clan taints work as for ghouls (V20, ch. 7).
GhoulLife.StreakTip: More than 4 points of one clan's blood in a row — Stamina check (diff 5) against the clan taint.
GhoulLife.ExcessTip: Points held above the limit. While they remain: frenzy at vampire difficulty, Dexterity +1, Perception + Self-Control each scene against hallucinations.
GhoulLife.SpoiledTip: Extra points are useless and the whole pool doesn't work until they are purged (takes a scene).
GhoulLife.WithdrawalOn: Withdrawal: week {w} of {n}. Refuse vitae — Self-Control (diff 7); weekly Intelligence + Self-Control (diff 6).
GhoulLife.DiscDueTip: 6 months without vitae — −1 Discipline dot, then −1 more each month.
GhoulLife.AgeTip: More than a month without vitae: under 100 — ages normally, 100–250 — ten times faster, over 250 — crumbles to dust (from the Age field).

TaintText.brujah: Frenzy at vampire difficulty until the ghoul drinks another clan's blood.
TaintText.malkavian: A mild derangement (record it under Derangements).
TaintText.setite: Direct sunlight makes the skin itch: −1 die to all pools.
TaintText.sabbat: High risk of infection through the Vaulderie.
TaintText.other: A weakened clan flaw — Storyteller's call.

GhoulLife.TaintGot: {actor} has drunk too much of one clan: {taint}.
GhoulLife.TaintGone: Another clan's blood washed the taint away: {taint}.
GhoulLife.ClanNote: More than 4 points in a row ({n}): failure — a weakened clan flaw until the ghoul drinks another clan's blood.
GhoulLife.OverNote: Success — the point is kept. Failure — 1 lethal per extra point, extras are useless, the whole pool fails until purged.
GhoulLife.OverCap: {actor} can't hold more: {n} extra lost (one extra point per Stamina dot).
GhoulLife.OverFail: {actor}: the blood is rejected — {n} lethal, the whole pool fails until the excess is purged.
GhoulLife.Purged: {actor} purges the excess blood (a scene). The pool works again.
GhoulLife.HallNote: Each scene while extra points remain. Difficulty not given in the book — 6.
GhoulLife.HallFail: {actor} sees things that aren't there until the scene ends.
GhoulLife.PurgeTip: Purge the excess blood (takes a scene)
GhoulLife.RefuseNote: During withdrawal — at any chance to drink vitae.
GhoulLife.RefuseOk: {actor} looks away from the cup — this time.
GhoulLife.WeekNote: Failure — a craving for blood, flesh or sex: indulge or spend 1 Willpower; botch — must indulge.
GhoulLife.WeekFail: {actor}: the craving turns to blood, flesh or sex — indulge or spend 1 Willpower.
GhoulLife.WeekBotch: {actor}: the craving is overwhelming — it must be indulged, Willpower won't help.
GhoulLife.LoseHint: 6 months without vitae — −1 Discipline dot, then −1 more each month.
GhoulLife.NoDisc: No Disciplines — the dot is written off.
GhoulLife.NightWeek: {actor}: a new withdrawal week — Intelligence + Self-Control (diff 6).
GhoulLife.NightAge: {actor}: a month without vitae — the years catch up.
GhoulLife.ThirdHint: A third drink of {name}'s blood means a full bond. A ghoul with Willpower below 6 may try to refuse: Self-Control check.
GhoulLife.ThirdNote: Difficulty not given in the book — 6.
GhoulLife.ThirdRefused: {actor} refuses a third drink of {name}'s blood.
GhoulLife.FrenzyVamp: Brujah blood taint or extra vitae: vampire difficulty (+3).

Lykeian.NightmareLegacyHint: The secondary Legacy — a twisting of the Thesis, a temptation. It can restore Willpower, at the cost of Nightmare.
Lykeian.AnalogHint: The mundane Guise object. If the Guise is destroyed, the Lykeian dies.
Lykeian.ThesisHint: One or two sentences: the calling, the dream that made the Lykeian. Acting against it is a Banality trigger.
Lykeian.NoGuise: No Guise chosen — pick one in the sheet header.
Lykeian.RivalHint: Sore Losers: +2 to all difficulties until the rival is beaten or an affirming act is done; 1 Willpower ignores it for a turn.
Lykeian.PanicNote: Willpower at zero: panic — +2 to all difficulties until the Lykeian sees a person or a made thing.
Lykeian.RedesHint: Instead of Arts and Realms — Redes worth 5 chimerical points; beyond that 2 freebies or 5 XP per point.
Lykeian.ImbalanceHint: Nightmare 10 — Imbalance on a Glamour dot; such dots hold only Nightmare-born Glamour. All dots Imbalanced — the Lykeian becomes a Nightmare.
Lykeian.Imbalance: {name}: Nightmare overflows — Imbalance on a Glamour dot ({n}).
Lykeian.Lost: {name}: every Glamour dot is Imbalanced — the Lykeian becomes a Nightmare.
Lykeian.LegacyHint: Glamour through a Legacy: a human fulfilled a Quest or Drive — as much Glamour as the Willpower they gained.
Lykeian.LegacyErase: Primary — erase Nightmare instead of Glamour (1 per point)
Lykeian.LegacyErased: {name} erases {n} Nightmare through the primary Legacy.
Lykeian.ShedHint: Remove a permanent Banality dot at the cost of a permanent Glamour dot
Lykeian.ShedNo: Nothing to shed or too little Glamour.
Lykeian.ShedDone: {name}: −1 permanent Banality for a Glamour dot.
Lykeian.CureHint: Remove an Imbalance at the cost of a permanent Willpower dot
Lykeian.CureNo: No Imbalance or too little Willpower.
Lykeian.CureDone: {name}: Imbalance removed for a Willpower dot.
Lykeian.ReapHint: Reaping — the Thallain way: a mortal dies of fear. Glamour roll (diff 5); always +1 Imbalance.
Lykeian.ReapDreamer: The victim was a Dreamer (+1 Banality)
Lykeian.ReapOk: {name} reaps a death: Glamour pool full. Imbalance: {n}.
Lykeian.ReapFail: {name}: no Glamour, but the Imbalance stays ({n}).

LyCr.NeedLegacy: Choose the primary Legacy of your Court.
LyCr.Tempers: Glamour {g}, Willpower {w}, Banality {b} — with the Shape bonus (humanoid +1 Willpower, animal +1 Willpower or Glamour, mythic +1 Glamour). No cantrips; Willpower costs 2 freebies, a Rede 2 per point.

Agenda.Title: Agendas
Agenda.None: No Agendas. An Agenda is an idea, law or campaign the character pushes in fae society.
Agenda.Hint: Players Guide, ch. 1: an extended action. The Storyteller sets pool, difficulty and target; you need the target and more successes than failures. Charisma or Manipulation 4+ and Law or Politics 3+ lower the target (1 each). Only one Agenda advances at a time. Helpers roll their own pools — add their successes with Help.
Agenda.TextHint: What the character wants passed, and before whom
Agenda.NeedHint: Successes needed; the mastery reduction is shown beside it
Agenda.TrackHint: Successes gathered toward the target; failures — rolls with no successes
Agenda.HelpHint: Helpers' successes or a Storyteller adjustment (+1 / −1)
Agenda.NotActive: Another Agenda is advancing — switch to this one first.
Agenda.RollNote: Extended action: successes add up, a botch wipes them.
Agenda.Botch: {actor}: a botch — the Agenda "{name}" falls back to the start.
Agenda.RivalHint: The Storyteller rolls for the opponent in a race: whoever reaches the target first wins.

Daf.OriginHint: Set Mists and Weaving by Origin (changeling 2/4, inanimae 3/3, firstborn 4/2)
Daf.MistsHint: Hides magic: Gift of Kenning, hide a cantrip (1), enhance mien; roll the permanent rating.
Daf.WeavingHint: Grounds magic: removes Unleashing dice 1 for 1, quenches cantrips, 2 points — −1 Echo success, forges Oaths.
Daf.EchoesHint: What repels and harms the fae: faith, wards, iron, bells. Everyone starts with 1.

Imbalance.mists: Imbalance: Mists 3 above Weaving — cantrips +1 difficulty.
Imbalance.weaving: Imbalance: Weaving 3 above Mists — Unleashing +1 difficulty.

Daf.Hint: Dark Ages: Fae. A cantrip is Dominion + Trait (book difficulty); −1 for the Court's favored Dominion, the Dominion's juncture (noon, midnight, dawn, dusk), solstice or equinox (minimum 4). One cantrip per known Dominion per Weaving dot, level up to the Dominion. Unleash when no cantrip fits.
Daf.UnleashHint: Base pool Mists + Dominion and Unleashing dice (5, firstborn 3); Weaving removes them 1 for 1, 5 is safe. Base successes at least as many — in control.

Unleash.wild: {name}: the effect works but runs wild ({b} vs {w}).
Unleash.fail: {name}: the Unleashing fails — the Dominion strikes back.

Daf.EchoHint: Storyteller's Echo roll: 10 dice, diff. 7, minus modifiers for Traits, visible cantrips and Unleashing. The window shows the math.

EchoLevel.1: Minor discomfort: a step back, −1–2 dice.
EchoLevel.3: Nature partly revealed; up to 3 bashing.
EchoLevel.4: No Dominions on the mortal, no Unleashing; up to 4 lethal.
EchoLevel.5: Banished for a day; grave aggravated wounds (a changeling gains two permanent Echoes).

Daf.IronHint: Cold iron: an aggravated wound and −1 temporary Mists
Daf.IronDone: {name}: cold iron — an aggravated wound, −1 Mists.

Hsien.YugenHint: Energy of mortal reverence; up to 2 × Rank. A Dragon Nest yields 1 Yugen a day per dot.
Hsien.WuTanHint: Pool: I Chih level + element Attribute + Chi (Yin or Yang); difficulty 10 − Chi. Modifier dice are taken from the pool; Fortune dice go to modifiers only. A cohort costs +1 Yugen per extra school.
Hsien.NeiBlocked: Chi is unbalanced — no Nei Tan level is available.
Hsien.NeiHint: Pool: Tao + an Attribute chosen by the Storyteller; difficulty 10 − Tao (system rule). Levels available: {cap}.
Hsien.NeiCapped: available up to {cap}: Yin and Yang diverge
Hsien.MaskHint: Spend Yugen: all who see roll Willpower (7; other shen 6; Hsien 5) and need at least that many successes. In a Dragon Nest — twice as many.
Hsien.MaskDone: {name} reveals a dreadful form of past glory: onlookers need {n} Willpower successes or flee or kneel.
Hsien.SacrificeHint: Sacrifice 1 Chi for 1 Yugen: 1 aggravated wound; the Chi returns only when it heals.
Hsien.Hint: Hsien: no Glamour or Banality. Rank = Yin + Yang, Tao is their average, Yugen up to 2 × Rank. Shentao replaces Kenning, Occult replaces Gremayre.

Inan.AnchorHint: The object or place binding the soul to the Autumn world: a personal freehold in the Near Dreaming.
Inan.HuskHint2: Mortal seeming: a week of use ages it a year, each Banality three years.
Inan.AnchorLostNote: Fading: in a Husk −1 Glamour a day, without one — an hour. Rebind with the anchor button.
Inan.HarvestHint: An hour in true form with your Empire's element: Perception + Kenning against Banality plus the place modifier; successes are Glamour.

PlaceMod.3: a similar substance of the same Empire

Inan.ReapHint: Tear Glamour from the world: Banality (diff 9), each success gives 1 Glamour and 1 Nightmare.
Inan.ReapDone: {name}: Reaping — {n} Glamour and as much Nightmare.
Inan.HuskHint: Manipulation + Husk against the highest Banality present, once a scene; failure — +1 Banality, botch — +2.
Inan.HuskFail: {name}: the Husk cracks — +1 Banality, it ages.
Inan.HuskBotch: {name}: the Husk gives itself away — +2 Banality.
Inan.RebindHint: Bind the soul to a new Anchor: Glamour (diff 7, 8 when changing court), then 1 Willpower.
Inan.RebindAsk: Is the new Anchor of the other court (Gladeling ↔ Krofted)?
Inan.NoWill: No Willpower to seal the binding.
Inan.RebindDone: {name} binds the soul to a new Anchor.
Inan.Hint: Inanimae: Slivers instead of Arts — Unleashing only; Gladelings start with a dot in the affinity Sliver, Krofted with Husk 1.

FaeCr.NeedChiDot: Where does the free Chi dot go — Yin or Yang?
FaeCr.NeiFree: Nei Tan at creation — freebie points only.
FaeCr.SchoolCap: At creation a Wu Tan school can't exceed 3.
FaeCr.DomCap: At creation a Dominion can't exceed 3.
FaeCr.CantripsHint: One cantrip per known Dominion per Weaving dot; level up to the Dominion. Common cantrips belong to every Dominion.
FaeCr.HsienTempers: Yin {yin}, Yang {yang}, Willpower {w}. No Glamour or Banality; Chi costs 4 freebies (up to 5), Wu Tan 5, Nei Tan only this way.
FaeCr.InanTempers: Glamour {g}, Willpower {w}, Banality {b} — by phylum. Gladelings get a free dot in the affinity Sliver; a Sliver costs 5 freebies, an Attribute 4.
FaeCr.DafTempers: Mists {m}, Weaving {wv}, Willpower {w}. Mists and Weaving cost 4 freebies a dot, a Dominion 7; the Court's favored Dominion gives −1 difficulty.

BondX.GhoulSecond: For a ghoul the second step works like a brotherly bond of strength 5.
BondX.Drink: A sip of the regnant's vitae
BondX.SameNight: Another sip of {name}'s blood on the same night — the bond doesn't strengthen, another night is needed.
BondX.Reinforced: {name}'s blood reinforces the full bond: it doesn't weaken.
BondX.AlreadyBound: A sip of {name}'s blood: it won't go past step 2 — there's already a full bond with {other}.
BondX.Step1: First sip of {name}'s blood: step 1 — strong feelings, dreams of the regnant.
BondX.Step2: Second sip of {name}'s blood: step 2 — acting against the regnant needs a Willpower roll, the regnant's social rolls against the thrall are −1 difficulty.
BondX.Step3: Third sip of {name}'s blood: a full bond. The regnant is the most important thing in life; Dominate works with a single word, resisting it is +2 difficulty.
BondX.Shattered: The full bond shattered all weaker ones: {names}.
BondX.ResistNeed: successes needed: {n} (more than the times the regnant's blood was drunk); costs 1 point of Willpower
BondX.ResistOk: The bond yields: {n} successes of the {need} needed. Freedom — from a turn (attacking them personally) to a scene (revealing a secret); after that — another Willpower roll.
BondX.ResistBotch: Botch: the thrall can't even think of resisting until the end of the scene.
BondX.Weakened: {actor}: the bond with {name} weakened — {from} → {to} (without the regnant's blood)
BondX.Broken: {actor}: the bond with {name} is broken — too long without their blood
BondX.FeedTip: Drink a Kindred's blood: the blood transfers, the bond grows by itself (a sip on a new night — a step)
BondX.FeedHint: The blood transfers from the donor; the bond grows a step if it's a new chronicle night. The donor gets a thrall entry.
BondX.FeedNameHint: if the donor isn't in the world
BondX.FeedNoDonor: Choose a donor or enter a name.

CheckPrompt.frenzy: {name}: {reason} — a frenzy check is due (Self-Control, difficulty {n}).
CheckPrompt.rotschreck: {name}: {reason} — a Rötschreck check is due (Courage, difficulty {n}).
CheckPrompt.NotOwner: Only whoever controls the character can roll the check.

PowerChoice.Hint: Level {level} of {disc} has several powers — the character knows one. Another can be taken later as a new power of the same level (at the Storyteller's discretion).
PowerChoice.Title: {disc}: level {level} power

Totem.label: Totem
Totem.title: Pack totem
Totem.short: {n} short — the pack must invest in the Totem Background
Totem.none: No totem chosen. The pack pools the Totem Background, the Storyteller picks the patron spirit.

Werewolf.RageHint: Current Rage / permanent. Rage — extra actions (no more than half of permanent per turn), instant shapeshifting, ignore stun; a Rage roll — frenzy.
Werewolf.GnosisHint: Current Gnosis / permanent: Gifts, fetishes, stepping sideways.
Werewolf.RenownHint: Permanent Renown in dots, temporary — ◇. Ten temporary — a permanent point.
Werewolf.RankHint: Rank: Gifts no higher than Rank; a new Rank — when Renown meets the auspice requirements and a challenge is made.
Werewolf.FrenzyHint: A roll of current Rage (diff. 6, Rank 3 — +1, Rank 4+ — +2): 4 or more successes — frenzy (Rank 5 — 5+).
Werewolf.StepHint: Stepping sideways: a Gnosis roll against the local Gauntlet (city — 8–9, wilderness — 5–6, caern — 2–4); a mirror or shiny surface helps.
Werewolf.GauntletNote: Difficulty — the local Gauntlet: caern 2–4, wilderness 5–6, suburbs 7, city 8–9.
Werewolf.BeastHint: The Beast within: Rage above Willpower — −{n} to social rolls.
Werewolf.FormHow: Instantly for a point of Rage — or a Stamina + Primal-Urge roll (diff. {diff}): {steps} successes needed, one for each form along the way.
Werewolf.AddGiftHint: Gifts of your breed, auspice and tribe no higher than Rank
Werewolf.GiftUse: Use the Gift: the cost is paid, then the roll
Werewolf.AddRiteHint: Rites no higher than the Rituals Ability
Werewolf.DiffByTargetNote: The difficulty depends on the target — adjust it in the dialog.
Werewolf.RankReady: Enough Renown for the next Rank — time to issue a challenge
Werewolf.SilverHint: Silver against Garou outside breed form (metis — in any form): aggravated, cannot be soaked. Homid and lupus in breed form take normal damage.
Werewolf.SilverHit: Silver: aggravated damage, cannot be soaked.
Werewolf.RegenHint: Heal the worst bashing or lethal level per turn; in combat — Stamina roll, difficulty 8.
Werewolf.RegenBreed: Homid and lupus in breed form don't regenerate — they heal like humans.
Werewolf.RegenAgg: Aggravated damage doesn't regenerate — 1 level per day of rest in a regenerating form.
Werewolf.ActionsHint: Spend Rage for extra actions: 1 point — 1 action, no more than half permanent Rage per turn.
Werewolf.ActionsNone: Not enough Rage for extra actions.
Werewolf.ActionsText: Up to {cap} per turn. Without penalty — {free} (lower of Dexterity and Wits); beyond that all difficulties +3 this turn. Extra actions come after normal ones, in initiative order; the pool isn't split.
Werewolf.ActionsFastNote: Beyond Dexterity and Wits: all difficulties +3 this turn.
Werewolf.AttuneHint: Attune: Gnosis against the fetish's Gnosis, 1 success needed
Werewolf.UseHint: Awaken: roll Gnosis against the item's Gnosis or spend 1 Gnosis
Werewolf.AttuneNote: 1 success needed; on a failure the fetish rejects its owner, next try no sooner than the next moon.
Werewolf.UseFetish: Awaken the fetish: roll Gnosis (diff. {g}) or spend 1 Gnosis — then the power works automatically.
Werewolf.UseTalen: Use the talen: roll Gnosis (diff. {g}) or spend 1 Gnosis. The talen is gone after use.
Werewolf.DeliriumBtnHint: Mortals seeing the Crinos: reactions by Willpower for targeted tokens (no targets — the table for the Storyteller)
Werewolf.DeliriumHint: Reaction to the Crinos by Willpower. Wits + Occult (diff. 9) — +1 Willpower per success if the Storyteller allows; Kinfolk are immune.
Werewolf.DeliriumNoTargets: No targets — the table for the Storyteller.

DeliriumR.terror: Terror: flees, but rationally — locks doors, drives off
DeliriumR.controlled: Controlled fear: flees or fights deliberately
DeliriumR.bloodlust: Bloodlust: enraged, will hunt it down

Spirit.tplHint: Take the template's traits, Essence and Charms; the description goes to the Storyteller in chat
Spirit.specialOf: A special Charm of “{name}” — see its description.
Spirit.title: Spirit
Spirit.essenceHint: Essence = Willpower + Rage + Gnosis — recalculate and fill
Spirit.stepHint: Materialize and cross: Gnosis against the local Gauntlet
Spirit.toggleHint: The creature is an Umbral spirit: Rage, Gnosis, Willpower, Essence and Charms instead of Morality
Spirit.willpowerHint: Willpower — attack and defense, instead of Dexterity and Stamina
Spirit.gnosisHint: Gnosis — instead of Social and Mental Attributes, for Charms
Spirit.noOwn: No Charms of its own — add one from the list or take a spirit template.
Spirit.useHint: Spend Essence as the Charm’s text says and post the Charm to chat
Spirit.costHint: Essence cost — as written in the Charm’s text

Werewolf.GauntletSub: Difficulty is the local Gauntlet rating · Gnosis {n}
Werewolf.GauntletAsk: Where are you? The difficulty is the local Gauntlet rating.
Werewolf.GauntletTimes: Successes: 1 — 5 minutes, 2 — 30 seconds, 3+ — at once. Failure — wait an hour; botch — caught in the Gauntlet.

Fetch.title: Kin-fetch
Fetch.bindHint: Baptism of Fire: create a guardian spirit and bind it to this Kinfolk
Fetch.burnHint: First Change: the brand burns, the fetch flies to the tribe
Fetch.bound: {name}: kin-fetch “{fetch}” bound, the brand is set.
Fetch.burned: {name}: the fetch brand burned — “{fetch}” carries word of the First Change to the tribe.

Fomor.title: Fomor — Bane-possessed
Fomor.breedHint: Take the breed's powers and Willpower (existing powers stay)
Fomor.specialOf: A special power of “{name}” — see its description.

Kami.title: Kami — Gaia's chosen
Kami.geasPh: a taboo drawn from the Kami's purpose
Kami.hint: Attributes 6/4/3, Abilities 11/7/3, 1–3 powers; humans get 21 freebies (a new power costs 7). Breaking the Geas strips powers.

Numen.title: Numina
Numen.hint: Hedge magic and psychic phenomena. At creation — freebies: first numen 7 per dot, second 14; later — experience at the Storyteller's discretion. Hedge magic works only through rituals: one ritual of each level gained in a Way. True Faith is a separate mortal trait.

Kin.title: Garou Kinfolk
Kin.gnosisHint: Kinfolk Gnosis comes from the Gnosis merit; without it — only Gifts that don't spend Gnosis
Kin.hint: Level 1 Gifts only: for experience (own — 15, other — 20) or as a reward from Garou and spirits. Kinfolk are immune to the Delirium.

Werewolf.DeliriumKin: Kinfolk, Kami or fomor — immune to the Delirium
Werewolf.RenownAwardHint: Award Renown: a deed from the W20 table or your own; Recognition at 10 temporary
Werewolf.FormDeliriumNote: Mortals in the scene will see this form — the Delirium.
Werewolf.FormNeedSteps: Successes needed: {n} — one per form along the way
Werewolf.ActionsFreeSub: No penalty up to {free}: the lower of Dexterity and Wits
Werewolf.ActionsLead: Extra actions come after normal ones, in initiative order; the pool isn't split.
Werewolf.TalenGone: The talen is gone once used
Werewolf.UseSpendSub: The power just works · Gnosis now {n}
Werewolf.RenownStatusTip: Permanent / needed for the next Rank
Werewolf.RenownBurn: {r}: temporary below zero — a permanent dot burned

Thrall.homid: Devourer of Souls: after killing or downing a foe — Wits (diff. 7); on a botch the turn goes to eating the victim.
Thrall.metis: Defiler: after killing or downing a foe — Wits (diff. 7); on a botch the turn goes to desecrating the body.
Thrall.lupus: Beast of War: after killing or downing a foe — Wits (diff. 7); on a botch it tears the corpse apart.

Werewolf.FrenzyMoon: Moon: {moon}. Frenzy — {n}+ successes; 6+ — Thrall of the Wyrm.
Werewolf.FrenzyKinds: Berserk — Crinos or Hispo and attack; fox — Lupus and flee. In frenzy: only bite, claws, running.
Werewolf.FrenzyExit: Exit — once the trigger is gone: Willpower roll, difficulty {n} (Rage).
Werewolf.FeraHint: Garou — or one of the Changing Breeds: each has its own forms, Gifts and traits.
Werewolf.NoDeformities: No deformities. A metis must have at least one — hiding it is dishonourable.
Werewolf.CraftHint: Bind a spirit into the chosen fetish (Rite of the Fetish) or talen (Rite of Binding)
Werewolf.CraftPick: Pick a fetish or talen in the list.

Werewolf.CraftTalenHow: Rite of Binding: the spirit is present and not hostile to the totem. Willpower roll against the spirit's Gnosis ({g}); each Gnosis spent lowers it by 1.
Werewolf.CraftNoRite: The sheet lacks {rite} — only with the Storyteller's leave.
Werewolf.CraftFail: The spirit did not enter {name}: the rite failed — the spirit may bear a grudge.
Werewolf.HaranoOn: {name}: Harano — despair for the dying world, −1 die to every roll.

Werewolf.ScarPickSub: The Storyteller picks the scar; each grants temporary Glory
Werewolf.StayUpHint: Below Incapacitated: Rage roll diff 8, each success heals a level; once per scene, the wound becomes a battle scar
Werewolf.StayUpUsed: Already rose on Rage this scene
Werewolf.StayUpNote: Each success heals one level of any damage; 4+ successes — frenzy
Werewolf.StayUpDone: {name} rises on Rage: {n} health levels healed
Werewolf.StayUpScar: The wound they rose from becomes a battle scar.
Werewolf.RageRegainHint: Moon, start of story, humiliation or start of a fight
Werewolf.RageMoonGain: First sight of the moon tonight: +{n}
Werewolf.RageStorySub: Roll a die — that much Rage now, even above permanent
Werewolf.RageOneSub: Botch (with the Storyteller's approval), humiliation, start of a fight
Werewolf.HaranoCheckHint: Harano Prone: Willpower roll in a scene with a failure
Werewolf.HaranoRollSub: Failure — temporary Harano (−1 die to every pool), botch — also a temporary derangement
Werewolf.HaranoDelaySub: Delay the check for a scene

Werewolf.HaranoDiffNote: The book gives no difficulty — 6, the Storyteller may change it
Werewolf.HaranoHeld: {name} holds on — Harano does not take them
Werewolf.HaranoBotch: {name}: Harano and a temporary derangement — pick it in the derangements library
Werewolf.FetishRejectedNote: “{name}” rejected its owner: attune again after reconciling with the spirit
Werewolf.FetishRejected: The spirit of “{fetish}” rejected {name}: try again only after reconciling

Werewolf.GnosisMeditateSub: Wits + Enigmas, diff {d}; once a day

Werewolf.GnosisDealSub: +1 per Essence point the spirit gives
Werewolf.GnosisStoryNote: The book gives no difficulty — 6, the Storyteller may change it
Werewolf.ActionsQueued: They are taken after everyone's normal actions, in initiative order.
Werewolf.FrenzyCalm: The Rage stays quiet: no frenzy.

Challenge.NotReady: Not enough Renown for the next Rank yet
Challenge.Title: Rank challenge: {name}
Challenge.Rule: To become {n}, challenge a Garou of that Rank or one step higher. The challenged chooses the trial — from a dominance duel to a quest; victory grants the new Rank. Challenging too high or too low a Rank is dishonorable (W20, ch. 3).
Challenge.TrialHint: chosen by the challenged — may be left blank
Challenge.PassageText: {name} undergoes the Rite of Passage — a cub becomes {r} without a challenge.
