Werewolf.KlaiveLoss: While the blade is carried, effective Gnosis is {n} lower — Gnosis rolls already account for it.

Strategy.Title: City strategy
Strategy.EmptyGm: The city isn't laid out yet. Pick a starting set — spheres and sectors can be renamed, added and moved later in “Layout”.
Strategy.EmptyPlayer: The Storyteller hasn't laid out the city yet.
Strategy.PickSector: Pick a hex to see its influence and your bids.
Strategy.Fog: Someone else is here too, but you don't know who. Scouting will tell.
Strategy.RevealOn: Hidden: everyone sees only their own — reveal to all

KindHint.attention: The character's personal attention: three tokens per turn.
KindHint.influence: One token per 2 dots of Influence; works best paired with attention.
KindHint.retainer: A ghoul or retainer acts alone — one token per dot of Retainers. A botch means trouble to sort out in play.
KindHint.boon: Call in outside help — afterwards you owe them (recorded in the boons ledger).
KindHint.kinfolk: The Garou's human kin: one token per 2 dots of the Kinfolk Background.

IntentHint.grow: 3 successes this turn in this hex give an influence token, 5 or more give two. Successes from all your bids here add up.
IntentHint.displace: Difficulty +1. Every 3 successes over the target's resistance remove their token and place yours.
IntentHint.undermine: Every 3 successes over the target's resistance remove their token — nothing for you.
IntentHint.scout: Even one success shows whose influence is here and how much.
IntentHint.defend: Successes add to the resistance of your tokens in this hex for the whole turn.
IntentHint.curb: Against a trend in this hex: every 3 successes lower it a step (5+ — two). A trend curbed this turn doesn't grow.
IntentHint.project: Successes go to your project's track in this hex — they add up turn after turn until the project is done.

Strategy.HelperHint: Who helps and what motivates them
Strategy.PoolLine: Pool {dice} (your tokens here: +{own}), difficulty {diff} — about {mean} successes per roll.
Strategy.TextHint: What exactly you do, in the game's words: whom you bribe, through whom you act, what you risk…
Strategy.NeedTarget: Choose who the bid is against.
Strategy.NoActor: You have no character who could take turns.
Strategy.TurnHint: Place tokens on the hexes and mark “Turn done” when finished. You can edit until the Storyteller closes bids.
Strategy.TurnClosedHint: Bids are closed — the Storyteller is resolving the turn.
Strategy.NoPlayersYet: No one has placed bids yet.
Strategy.ModDiceHint: Dice for the bid: good and in-lore +1…+2, a stretch −1…−2

Out.full: {who}: no room — the hex is full, displace someone.
Out.heat: {sector}: crude work left traces — the Masquerade is at risk.
Out.domainUp: {name}: Security rose to {n} — the quarter backs its owner.
Out.domainDown: {name}: Security fell to {n} — rivals hold the quarter.

Strategy.Trouble: Retainer of {who} got into trouble — a story for the session.
Strategy.Publish: Publish and start a new turn
Strategy.QuietTurn: All quiet on the surface: no visible shift in the balance of power.
Strategy.NpcHint: A move for an NPC or faction: set the pool yourself (usually Attribute + Ability or the faction's rating); their tokens in the hex are added.
Strategy.DragHint: Drag onto a hex to open a bid with this token.
Strategy.HistoryShow: Show the hexes after this turn
Strategy.GuideMissing: The guidebook isn't in the rules compendium.
Strategy.SwayHint: The action leans on your influence in a city sphere (Strategy): +1 die per 2 tokens in the sector.
Strategy.FactionsHint: Influence isn't only Kindred: mages, the Technocracy, werewolves, gangs, corporations. Characters needn't be added — they're in the holder list already.
Strategy.DeleteSector: Delete the sector “{name}” with all influence in it?
Strategy.AboutHint: What this sphere is and what influence here gives
Strategy.WipeConfirm: Erase all strategy sectors, influence, turns and reports? Report journals stay.
Strategy.Full: A hex holds at most {n} tokens.
Strategy.PerkLineSector: Influence here gives: {name} (+1 die per 2 tokens in downtime).
Strategy.PerkHuntLine: Influence here eases hunting: difficulty −1 (−2 from 5 tokens).
Strategy.PerkHint: What influence in the sector gives: dice to a background in downtime, or easier hunting
Strategy.TrendStorm: The trend rages: all bids in this hex at difficulty +1; at level five it erodes the strongest holder.
Strategy.TrendNew: New trend: riot, epidemic, gang war…
Strategy.ProjectNew: New project: found a lodge, install your own mayor…
Strategy.ProjectHint: Start a project in this hex; invest in it with “Invest in a project” bids. The Storyteller sets the track goal (10 by default).
Strategy.PactHint: Players agree in play, the Storyteller records it. A pact goes into both boon ledgers; displacing or undermining the partner within the pact is a breach: it shows in the report, and the breaker owes a major boon.
Strategy.ProxyHint: Act through a front: the target sees them in the report, not you. Difficulty +1; pact breaches through a front stay hidden.
Strategy.CrudeHint: Kidnapping, murder, Dominating crowds: +1 die, but Masquerade heat rises in the sector's district (more on a failure).
Strategy.ShiftHint: How far to move the chronicle clock when the report is published — you can change or skip it before the shift.
Strategy.ShiftAsk: Move the chronicle clock by the turn span? You can change the span or not move it at all; undo later in “Reports”.
Strategy.ClockUndoAsk: Move the chronicle clock back by {span}?
Strategy.NotifyClosed: Bids for turn {n} are closed — the Storyteller is resolving the turn.
Strategy.NotifyOpened: Bids for turn {n} are open again.
Strategy.NotifyPublished: Turn {n} report is out. Turn {next} is open — place your tokens.
Strategy.PerkCaernLine: A caern lies here: stepping sideways is easier — Gauntlet −1 per 2 tokens (at most −2).
Strategy.DomainHeld: Turn {n}: the quarter's tokens favour the owner — Security {sec}.
Strategy.DomainLost: Turn {n}: {who} is stronger in the quarter — Security {sec}.
Strategy.ZoomHint: Mouse wheel zooms toward the cursor; drag the board to pan
Strategy.OvLead: Hexes on the table: {n}. Click a sphere to highlight its hexes.
Strategy.Contested: Contested hex: the leaders are tied
Strategy.ReadyWait: Still thinking: bids placed, turn not submitted
Strategy.PerkNodeLine: A Node lies here: stepping sideways is easier for a mage — Gauntlet −1 per 2 tokens (up to −2).
Strategy.FactionTechHint: Five Conventions as board factions with starting influence of 2 tokens: NWO — media and telecom, Syndicate — finance and high society, Iteration X — industry, Progenitors — health, Void Engineers — university (system rule)
Strategy.FactionDeadHint: Stygia’s four factions as board factions with starting influence of 2 tokens: Hierarchy — courts and council, Renegades — crime and unions, Heretics — church, Ferrymen — port and the wilds (system rule)

GarouCr.Title: Garou creation
GarouCr.AttrHint: 7 / 5 / 3 by group — the wizard picks which group gets what, whichever is cheapest
GarouCr.AbilHint: 13 / 9 / 5, at most 3 at creation — higher only with freebies
GarouCr.CostHint: W20 costs: Attribute 5, Ability 2, Background 1, Gift 7, Rage 1, Gnosis 2, Willpower 1. Flaws give points, at most 7.
GarouCr.NeedGifts: Three Gifts are needed: breed, auspice and tribe.
GarouCr.NeedDeformity: A metis needs at least one deformity.
GarouCr.Done: {name}: the Garou is created. Welcome to the Nation.
GarouCr.NeedFera: Pick everything for the breed: breed form, aspect and the rest.
GarouCr.NeedFeraGifts: Starting Gifts of the breed are needed — one in each slot.
GarouCr.GiftNeedPick: First pick the {what} on the Breed & Tribe step.
GarouCr.FeraRenown: Fera: 3 dots in any mix (each breed names its Renown its own way)
GarouCr.GiftGeneralFull: You already have {n} general Gifts: drop one to take another.

Sept.Title: Sept
Sept.Rule: A sept is the Garou and Kinfolk of one caern. Positions require Sept Standing; each dot above it — +1 die to social rolls with sept members.
Sept.EmptyGM: Create a sept on the left.
Sept.EmptyPlayer: Your character belongs to no sept.
Sept.TotemRule: A sept totem costs no Background; it can be called once per lunar month; its ban is a principle for the whole sept.
Sept.StandingRule: Standing: • Known, •• Respected, ••• Valued, •••• Honored, ••••• Lauded.

Umbra.Title: Umbra
Umbra.FindHint: Intelligence + Enigmas, diff. 7 — find the way (in the Pattern Web without Web Walker)
Umbra.Pick: Pick a place on the left.

Sins.Ask: Path: {path}, rating {n}. What was done? Sins above {n} (dimmed) need no check.
Sins.Safe: {name}: “{sin}” ({r}) is above rating {n} — no degeneration check.

Group.NoMembers: No one yet — drag characters from the directory.
Group.DropHint: Drag a character in to add a member, a domain to set the Domain.
Group.Primary: Base: no shared Background is higher
Group.RatingHint: Rating works as Domain Background dots: when the owner or their coterie hunts, it lowers the difficulty together with Fame.
Group.HoldingsHint: havens, clubs, businesses, the owner's people
Group.DropMember: Drag a character sheet from the directory here to add them
Group.DropOwner: Drag the owner's sheet — a character or a coterie
Group.DropGuest: Drop a sheet: the owner allowed them to hunt
Group.DropPerson: Drop a sheet: the owner's ghoul, Herd, servant

StatHint.rating: V20: each dot is −1 to hunting difficulty for the owner and guests, +1 blood at the start of play. 1 — a house or business; 3 — a block; 5 — a district, an ethnic enclave.
StatHint.security: V20: each dot is +1 to the difficulty to sneak in and for uninvited vampires to hunt, −1 to find and identify trespassers.
StatHint.prosperity: DA Companion: each dot is −1 to Commerce difficulty; Resources up to this rating cost half the maturation experience.
StatHint.passages: DA Companion: each dot is −1 to difficulty to hide and evade attention for those who know the domain.

Group.StartBlood: Size {n}: +{n} blood at the start of play for the owner
Group.PoolHint: V20: Domain may be shared — both size and security.
Group.PopulaceLine: {h} households (as many militia), ~{p} people, {a} sq. miles
Group.PopulaceNone: Herd may be turned into Population (DA Companion).
Group.ServantsLine: Management and Leadership in domain affairs: difficulty −{n}; up to {k} servants on a journey
Group.ServantsNone: Without servants the estate merely doesn't fall apart.
Group.FeudalHint: DA Companion: for each dot the liege grants a vassal as an anchor, the vassal gives 2; revoking an anchor costs the liege 1 dot. The combined domain is own size plus the vassals'.
Group.HavenNoPool: Add the shared Background Communal Haven in Shares and base — its dots are split here.

curse.name: Curse
curse.text: −1 or more to Herd (Population) or local Resources until lifted; may draw a Saint.

disaster.name: Disaster
disaster.text: −1 or more to Herd (Population), Size or Prosperity; servants restore as many dots as their rating. Unrepaired — Invasion, Brigands, Famine.

saint.name: Saint
saint.text: True Faith, miracles; staying a season or longer — Resources +1 while here. Pilgrims, Heresy.

famine.name: Famine
famine.text: −1 or more to Herd (Population), in time to Servants; Brigands.

invasion.name: Invasion
invasion.text: Mass combat: households are the militia, servants are troops, Allies and vassals other forces. A long war cuts Population, a siege — Size and outside Resources.

court.name: Liege's visit
court.text: Servants at least the liege's Status or Influence; cover the gap with Resources (−1 Resources dot). Failure — punishment, success — Resources, Influence, standing.

heresy.name: Heresy
heresy.text: Gives Influence over its followers but risks excommunication: lost Influence, Kindred Status, Resources.

miracle.name: Miracle
miracle.text: True Faith in a place or object (or a fake): Resources, Influence, Status; Pilgrims, Heresy.

brigands.name: Brigands
brigands.text: Take Prosperity, Resources, Herd (Population); lawlessness hits Influence and Status.

pilgrims.name: Pilgrims
pilgrims.text: One domain Resource +1 while they stay; with hospitality — permanently.

strategy.name: City strategy
strategy.text: A strategy turn shifted the domain's Security: whoever has more tokens in the quarter's sectors (system rule).

trend.name: Trend in the quarter
trend.text: A trend rose on the strategy board in the domain's quarter.

Group.SwayLine: Quarter «{district}»: the owner has {mine} tokens, the rival {best}{who} — at turn end {sway}.
Group.EventTrend: The event became a trend on the strategy board: {name}
Group.TotemPoolNoAccess: The totem's pool is changed by the Storyteller or the pack sheet's owner
Group.TotemBanned: Totem ban broken — no bonuses until the Rite of Contrition
Group.TotemBannedNote: Ban broken: totem bonuses are off until the Rite of Contrition
Group.TotemPoolEmpty: The totem's pool is spent for this story
Group.TotemBanOn: {pack}: ban broken — the totem withdraws all bonuses until the Rite of Contrition
Group.TotemBanOff: {pack}: Rite of Contrition — the totem restores its bonuses
Group.TotemSpendHint: Spend a point instead of your own
Group.TotemRefillHint: The totem's pools refill at the end of each story
Group.TotemAcceptHint: Each Garou of the pack gains temporary Renown from individual traits (once per totem) and Attribute bonuses
Group.ChantryPointsHint: Chantry Background points pooled by the cabal: 10–20 — squat, 21–30 — small sanctum, 31–70 — chantry, 71–100 — fortress, 101+ — seat of power
Group.NodeRateHint: Quintessence a Node dot yields per week: 2 — ordinary world, 5–10 — high magick, 1 — magick is dying (Storyteller's call)
Group.NodeWeekHint: A week has passed: +{free} free Quintessence and +{tass} Tass to the stock
Group.NodeWeekMsg: {name}: the Node gave its weekly yield — free Quintessence +{free}, Tass +{tass}.
Group.NodeNone: The chantry has no Node — no yield.
Group.NodeDrawHint: Draw a point from the chantry stock (free Quintessence first, then Tass)
Group.LibraryHint: shared Background: the chantry's books and archives
Group.NodeAvatarFull: {name}: the Avatar holds no more — personal Quintessence cannot exceed the Avatar rating ({n}).

Session.Title: Session panel
Session.ToToken: To the token on its scene

Degen.Botch: Botch: {virtue} −1 (now {n}) and a derangement — chosen by player and Storyteller.
Degen.Beast: Morality at zero — the Beast has won: the character goes to the Storyteller.

Instinct.Lead: Instinct {n}: no roll to resist — the character frenzies. If the provocation's difficulty is below Instinct, they may choose not to.
Instinct.CanResist: Provocation {d} is below Instinct {n} — the frenzy may be refused.
Instinct.NoResist: Provocation {d} is not below Instinct {n} — frenzy is unavoidable.

Instinct.Frenzied: {name} frenzies (provocation {d}). To act consciously — “ride the wave”: an Instinct roll.
Instinct.RideNote: In frenzy: success — a conscious action, the frenzy goes on

PathShift.Btn: Take a Path of Enlightenment (leave Humanity)
PathShift.OnlyHumanity: Only a vampire on Humanity can switch to a Path.
PathShift.Title: Switch to a Path: {name}
PathShift.Lead: Humanity {n}. Required: Humanity 3 or less, replaced Virtues at 1, a mentor of this Path, a year of study and a trial with a monstrous act. Willpower roll, difficulty {d}; Willpower can't buy a success.

Cond.trial: The trial passed — the monstrous act understood

PathShift.RollNote: Success — Path 1 (3+ successes — Path 2), new Virtues at 1
PathShift.Fail: {name} commits a senseless atrocity, but the Path doesn't open: Humanity {n}. May try again in a month.
PathShift.Botch: {name}: botch — the Path is closed, may try again only in a year.

Embrace.Btn: Embrace: a mortal or ghoul becomes Kindred — clan and generation from the sire, first step of the bond
Embrace.Title: Embrace: {name}
Embrace.Hint: A Kindred drains and feeds their blood: clan from the sire, generation is sire's + 1, the childe is bound to the sire at the first step. Attributes, Abilities, Virtues, Humanity, Willpower, Backgrounds and items stay; clan Disciplines are added at 0 dots.
Embrace.SireName: Sire's name (if not in the world)
Embrace.NoInert: Angra Mainyu cannot Embrace: their blood is inert.
Embrace.NoDies: Blood Brothers cannot Embrace: the mortal dies.
Embrace.DoneBond: First step of the blood bond to the sire ({sire}).

Vessel.Label: Vessel
Vessel.Rich: Werewolf blood is potent: more than 3 points may be drunk per turn.
Vessel.Dose: How much (100 g of spirits / strength)
Vessel.Noticed: {name} notices the disease in the vessel's blood — and does not drink.
Vessel.Carrier: {name} now carries a blood disease: the Disease Carrier flaw is on the sheet.

SubFx.alcohol: −1 die to Dexterity and Intelligence per 100 g, fading by a die per hour.
SubFx.stimulant: Celerity +1 for those who have it for (10 − Stamina) minutes; frenzy checks +1 difficulty.
SubFx.hallucinogen: −1 to −3 dice to all pools; Alertness or Auspex may rise; like Hallucinations for (8 − Stamina) minutes.
SubFx.opiate: −2 dice to Dexterity and all Abilities for (10 − Stamina) minutes; dozing for (12 − Stamina) hours; −1 difficulty against frenzy.
SubFx.marijuana: Time distortion, −1 die to Perception for about 30 minutes.
SubFx.poison: −1 die to all pools; 1–3 lethal per scene or turn by toxicity — the Storyteller; remove the effect once the tainted blood is spent.
SubFx.food: Nausea: cannot drink blood (Stamina diff 6 to override for a while), 1 bashing; about a day.

TP.NoTarget: No target: difficulty is the victim's {what}, set it manually.
TP.DomGeneration: “{name}” is of lower generation: Dominate cannot affect stronger blood

Limb.head: the face twitches, no speech: +2 difficulty to social rolls

TP.WaterVamp: {n} blood turned to water: wound penalty as from that much damage; the water leaves a point an hour
TP.SleepDesc: Sleeps 5–10 hours, without nightmares or derangements; can be woken normally.
TP.DustVamp: pale and gaunt: Appearance −1 until the next night

TP.Atrophy1: the limb withers: +2 difficulty to actions with it

PathNote.Subvert: gives in to suppressed desires; at a good chance — yield or spend 1 Willpower

sheet.title: Character sheet
sheet.lead: Everything about the character on one page; tabs on the left.

1.d: Click an Attribute or Ability name to open the roll window: second trait, difficulty, Willpower, specialty are there.

2.d: Dots are clicked only during creation; afterwards growth goes through the Experience window (button at the bottom).

3.d: At the top: spend blood by clicking a drop, Willpower with “Spend”, damage and healing by the health track. Wound penalties apply to rolls automatically.

4.d: Disciplines tab: expand a Discipline and click the die by a power. The icon next to it toggles effect powers.

5.d: Effects tab — everything active now: powers, conditions, poisons, curses. An effect can be removed there too.

6.d: The (i) button in a window header shows and hides short explanations inside that window.

hud.title: HUD
hud.lead: The panel at the bottom for the selected token — the essentials without opening the sheet.

1.d: Fight, Blood, Powers, Other — above the portrait. Select your token and the HUD shows it.

2.d: Powers tab: a Discipline icon opens its powers, click a power to roll or toggle it.

3.d: Weapons, maneuvers, “…” — the full attack window; dodge, block, parry — answering an attack. During declarations “Declare” comes first.

4.d: Spending blood, healing, Potence and Celerity extra actions for this turn.

5.d: Powers against a target take difficulty from the marked token: hover it and press T.

turn.title: Combat turn
turn.lead: Three phases per V20: initiative, declarations, actions.

1.d: Rolled every turn: 1d10 + Dexterity + Wits − wounds. The order card goes to chat. Ties — higher initiative rating.

2.d: From lowest initiative to highest. On your turn — a bell and a notice; “Declare” in the tracker or the HUD.

3.d: Declare “Multiple actions” — roll and attack windows split the pool themselves.

4.d: Declaring “Delay” — the character acts at the end of the turn.

5.d: If something else was declared, defending aborts it: a Willpower roll (diff. 6) or 1 Willpower. The system asks.

6.d: Extra actions come in a phase after everyone: the window shows how many are left and offers attack, a roll or movement.

fight.title: Attack and defense
fight.lead: Attack — defense — damage — soak: all through chat cards.

1.d: Mark a target (T) and open the attack: weapon or maneuver, aim, position. Nearby foes and firearm range fill in themselves.

2.d: The attack card has defense buttons for the target. Each further defense in a turn — one die less.

3.d: After a hit — the damage button, then the target soaks. Wounds go to the track automatically.

4.d: They last between turns: in a clinch both take Strength damage each turn. Break free — the HUD button (contested Strength + Brawl).

5.d: Fire or sunlight damage to a vampire — the system offers a Rötschreck check.

6.d: A mortal with a full track, a vampire in torpor or staked — marked defeated in the tracker automatically.

powers.title: Powers
powers.lead: Discipline powers 1–5 work per V20 text; choices are buttons.

1.d: Where a power has several modes, the window shows them as buttons with explanations — one click.

2.d: Difficulty comes from the target (Willpower, Courage…), the result is applied with a card button; the target's owner or the Storyteller clicks it.

3.d: If a rule forbids it, the system asks; bending a rule shows up for the Storyteller in chat. Without a target a power can be rolled plainly.

4.d: The “Use” window: blood and Willpower cost from the book (adjustable), a line to chat; a normal roll if needed.

5.d: “Custom work” — weapon, cost, body changes, soak, spikes; save templates under your own name.

6.d: Active powers and those laid on you are on the Effects tab; durations follow the chronicle clock.

blood.title: Blood and healing
blood.lead: Blood is fuel: Disciplines, physical traits, healing.

1.d: How much blood can be spent per turn depends on generation; the system tracks it.

2.d: 1 blood — bashing or lethal, 5 — aggravated. In combat — a choice: only heal this turn, or heal on the move (Stamina + Survival, diff. 8).

3.d: With blood for this turn: Potence — automatic Strength successes, Celerity — extra actions.

4.d: A “Check” card in chat: a Self-Control or Courage roll against the stimulus difficulty.

5.d: In the evening — minus a blood point, boosts reset; the “Awaken” button on the sheet.

chat.title: Chat cards
chat.lead: Every roll is a card: dice, result and what's next.

1.d: The edge color is the outcome: bone — success, brighter — exceptional, grey — failure, blood — botch.

2.d: The card's main action: damage, apply a power, take damage, roll a check.

3.d: Buttons on a target are clicked by its owner or the Storyteller; on your own card — by you.

4.d: At the start of a turn — the initiative card and the previous turn's summary: who took what and who is out.

gm.title: For the Storyteller
gm.lead: Time, scenes, experience and extras — from the top plate and the tracker.

1.d: Click the clock — calendar; the hourglass starts a scene (timer) and ends it (“until end of scene” effects are removed).

2.d: The star on the plate — session experience; ghoul retainers get half their domitor's experience automatically.

3.d: “Extras” during declarations — all NPC declarations in one window; the sword on an NPC row — its attack.

4.d: The tracker button ends declarations early; those delaying go to the end of the turn.

5.d: In the system settings: initiative every turn, quick initiative (6 + traits), the declaration phase — can be turned off.

6.d: A blood ring around the token whose turn it is; change it in the combat tracker settings.

BL.EndKept: the soul of {name} is kept ({k} of {cap}). A specific memory — Intelligence + Empathy, difficulty 5.
BL.EndHealed: the soul of {name} is consumed — bashing and lethal levels healed: {n}
BL.MensBackDesc: Mens Sana failed: the Salubri suffers “{name}” until the end of the scene.
BL.MensInnate: Innate Malkavian derangement — only suppressed until the end of the scene
BL.MensSuppDesc: The innate derangement is suppressed until the end of the scene.
BL.GroveNote: Blood: {b}. Success — the grove lasts the scene.
BL.GroveDesc: Consecrated grove ⌀ {m} m for the scene: foes inside −2 dice to all rolls; anyone entering — Stamina + Athletics or 3 bashing from the plants (where plants can harm).
BL.GroveWrathDesc: Botch: the angered spirits turn on the Lhiannan — −2 dice to their rolls until the end of the scene (system rule).
BL.WoadDesc: Woad for the scene: wound penalties −{n}, difficulty against Rötschreck −{n}, once — +{n} damage dice to one melee attack. More than 4 levels of damage taken wipe it away.
BL.WoadAsk: Add {n} Crimson Woad dice to this attack's damage? Only once while the power lasts.
BL.WoadGone: more than 4 levels of damage taken — the woad is wiped away, the spirits leave

Curse.body: Curse of the body (arm, leg, belly)
Curse.soul: Curse of the soul (over the heart)

CurseDesc.body: Mortal: +2 difficulty to physical rolls, wound penalties 1 worse. Vampire: cannot spend blood except to wake.
CurseDesc.mind: Every Knowledge roll and every supernatural power (except Potence, Fortitude, Celerity) costs 1 Willpower; spending only permits the roll.
CurseDesc.voice: Cannot speak words — only grunts, growls, moans.
CurseDesc.soul: +2 difficulty to resist frenzy. Non-vampires — Courage (difficulty 8) or flee the Lhiannan's land.

BL.CurseResist: A target who can read the name may lift it: Wits + Occult (Storyteller's difficulty). Lasts while the writing is intact; more than 3 damage levels on the Lhiannan make it illegible.
BL.CurseFlee: Animal terror: Courage (difficulty 8) — or flee the Lhiannan's territory.
BL.CurseGone: the Lhiannan took more than 3 levels of damage — the writing is illegible, the curse ends
BL.CurseNoBlood: “{name}” is active: the vampire cannot spend blood (except to wake each night).
BL.CurseMindWill: Curse of the mind: using a power costs 1 Willpower.
BL.MarkSun: Mark of the Sun (3 blood, 15 minutes)
BL.MarkMoon: Mark of the Moon (3 blood, 15 minutes)

MarkText.sun: bears the Mark of the Sun
MarkText.moon: bears the Mark of the Moon
MarkText.both: bears the Sun and the Moon

BL.SunDesc: Fire and sunlight damage: Stamina (difficulty 8) — on a success the damage is lethal, not aggravated.
BL.SunOk: the mark holds — the damage is lethal, not aggravated
BL.DrainFind: Seek a place of power (Perception + Occult, difficulty 8)
BL.DrainLink: Connect (1 blood, a scene of sigils)
BL.DrainDraw: Draw (difficulty 7, dice left in the source: {left})
BL.DrainFindNote: Search: one success — whether a place of power is near; more — the Lhiannan senses its depth (the Storyteller rates it).
BL.DrainFound: a place of power is found (successes: {n}) — the Storyteller names its depth 1–5
BL.DrainSrcDesc: Connected to a depth {d} source: draw once per turn, {n} dice in total. Drained dry — a wasteland forever; if not exhausted, it recovers in a year.
BL.DrainDrawNote: Reflexive, once per turn: each success (up to the depth) adds 2 dice to a pool until the end of the scene.
BL.DrainPoolDesc: Earth dice — for any roll until the end of the scene, except resisting frenzy and Rötschreck.
BL.DrainGot: +{n} dice to the pool; {left} left in the source
BL.DrainEmpty: +{n} dice — the source is drained, the place becomes a wasteland
BL.BroA: Toward an aggravated level (1 of 5, so far {n})
BL.BroText: a brother's blood heals one level
BL.BroAText: a brother's blood — toward an aggravated level (5 per level)
BL.BroPool: blood gathered toward an aggravated level: {n} of 5
BL.WalkKindred: {name} is not Kindred: there is no generation.
BL.Walk14: The Fourteenth generation cannot give a step.
BL.Walk4: {name} is already Fourth generation: it goes no lower.
BL.WalkGaveDesc: A generation step is lent: now {g}th. Duration as agreed in the chronicle; remove the effect when the step returns.
BL.WalkJoin: Walk of Caine: without the power (Stamina + Awareness)
BL.WalkFail: the step could not be accepted — generation unchanged
BL.WalkGotDesc: Generation one step lower — now {g}th. Remove the effect when the step returns.
BL.AidDesc: The awakened spirit of “{what}”: {n} dice in a pool — for rolls with this object, until the end of the scene.
BL.BeastDesc: A spirit of a local species in the flesh: health and attacks as an ordinary animal; follows simple mental commands. Discorporates at death. The Storyteller places the token with the button on the roll card.

AspectDesc.beaver: Bites through almost any material (bite damage unchanged).
AspectDesc.hare: Hearing: −2 difficulty to Perception (a checkbox in the roll window).
AspectDesc.falcon: Sight: −3 difficulty to Perception (a checkbox in the roll window).
AspectDesc.frog: Leaps three times as far and high.
AspectDesc.dog: Supernatural smell: tracking — Perception + Survival (Storyteller's difficulty).
AspectDesc.snake: The bite injects venom: 2 levels of damage per turn until neutralized or the power ends (type — Storyteller).
AspectDesc.cricket: A deafening chirp: listeners — Willpower (difficulty 7), or +4 difficulty to hearing until the end of the next scene.
AspectDesc.squirrel: Climbing trees, branches, ropes: −2 difficulty (a checkbox in the roll window).

BL.EnglingDone: a spirit is devoured — Willpower regained: {n}

WitherDesc.arm: The arm is shriveled and useless. Permanent for a mortal, healed only supernaturally.
WitherDesc.leg: The leg is shriveled and useless. Permanent for a mortal, healed only supernaturally.

BL.WitherHeadMortal: a mortal's head withers — death on the spot
BL.WitherHeadVamp: Mental Attributes −2; no Disciplines except Celerity, Fortitude and Potence.
BL.PutrefyVamp: one lethal level and Appearance −1 (a vampire recovers it in a night)
BL.PutrefyMortal: one lethal level and Appearance −1 — permanent until a surgeon fixes it; 3+ lethal in a scene — the Storyteller may rule gangrene
BL.NecrosisDesc: The traits return as the Necrosis wounds heal — then remove the effect. Strength or Dexterity 0 — can only crawl, but blood and Disciplines still work.
BL.NecrosisDone: lethal levels: {n}; traits — per the power's table
BL.RecurPlain: Plain (a minute + a minute per success)
BL.RecurBlood: With blood (+1 blood: minute, 10 minutes, hour, 6 hours, a day)
BL.RecurDesc: A light trance ({d}): relives a recent moment, oblivious to time and surroundings. A wound, a shout, thunder, a touch break it.
BL.LeadOne: One object or being (no larger than a person)
BL.LeadGroup: A group of like objects (+2 difficulty)
BL.LeadNote: Success — half speed; every 2 successes past the first — slower still. Lasts half the successes (round up).
BL.LeadDesc: Moves at 1/{k} speed, turns: {n}. Projectiles: hit and damage successes are divided; so are the target's Dexterity, Wits and Strength rolls.
BL.LeadBotch: botch — time slows for the vampire instead (1/{k})
BL.NornsDone: the object is in stasis — {d}. Touch by anything absent at casting breaks it.
BL.ClothoDesc: +{n} full actions every turn, turns: {turns}. A Discipline used as an extra action — 1 unsoakable aggravated level. Celerity or any other source of extra actions — Final Death.
BL.ClothoCelerity: Clotho's Gift is active: any other source of extra actions means immediate Final Death (V20).
BL.VirtMark: Target the listeners (T): Siren's Beckoning in chorus affects everyone targeted.
BL.VirtN: Virtuosa: {n} listeners, all hear the same.
BL.SirenCrowd: Virtuosa: {n} listeners; difficulty — the highest Willpower among them ({w}). Each resists separately.
BL.OctoAsk: What to lend to {name}? 1 blood per limb or external organ. Internal organs cannot be lent.
BL.OctoGaveDesc: Lent: {list}. While the parts are away, the donor lacks them: no hands — cannot hold, no eyes — cannot see, no mouth — cannot speak or feed. Remove the effect when the parts return.
BL.OctoText: will receive at the end of the turn: {list}
BL.OctoGotDesc: Borrowed: {list}. The recipient chooses where they grow. No extra actions or attacks: more hands hold and grapple more, more eyes see wider, a second mouth drinks twice as fast.
BL.EntityMark: Target (T) the Kindred of the circle who join the Coagulated Entity.
BL.EntityDesc: Coagulated Entity: {n} participants. Merging takes 3 turns. Strength, Stamina and Perception +{k}; +{k} dice to physical rolls; generation — {g}th. Health: {hp} more Bruised levels (tracked by the Storyteller). A stake through the heart does not paralyze. Lasts the scene.
BL.EntityInDesc: The body is merged into the Coagulated Entity; {name} is in control. Cannot act alone until the entity dissolves.
BL.BeastWho: Which beast appears (the species must live in the area)

NightSum.Title: Night summary
NightSum.Foot: Arrows show what changed since nightfall (the “Night” button).
NightSum.FootNoSnap: Nightfall was not marked with the “Night” button — only the current state is shown.

Mage.SphereTip: Own Sphere: {n}. Click a dot to set the rank used, the tile to add it in full or drop it.
Mage.RiskVulgar: Success earns Paradox +1; a botch earns +{n} (now {now}).
Mage.CapHint: Magick is rolled with Arete dice; no Sphere above Arete.
Mage.CappedHint: Permanent Willpower is below Arete: both magick dice and the Sphere cap are limited by Willpower.
Mage.OverCap: Above the cap: a Sphere cannot exceed Arete and permanent Willpower.
Mage.AffinityHint: One affinity Sphere: the first dot at creation, experience at current × 7 instead of × 8. A dot marks Spheres outside the faction's list.
Mage.WheelHint: The wheel: Quintessence from the left, Paradox from the right, 20 at most together. Paradox displaces Quintessence.
Mage.BacklashHint: Paradox backlash: roll the Paradox pool, difficulty 6 (Storyteller)
Mage.BackBotch: the roll botches — the Paradox ({n}) discharges harmlessly.
Mage.CastHintBtn: Casting: Spheres, coincidental or vulgar, Arete roll
Mage.CastWith: Cast an effect with this Sphere
Mage.CastHint: which Spheres and ranks the effect needs
Mage.CastName: What the mage does (effect or rote name)…

KindSub.coincidental: highest Sphere + {n}; Paradox only on a botch

Mage.QuintHint: −1 difficulty per point; have {n}, up to {max} per turn
Mage.ModTip: Personal or unique instrument −1; unneeded instrument −1; target's possession −1…−3; fitting Resonance −1; extra turn of preparation −1; near a Node −1…−3. Unfamiliar instruments +1…+2; no instruments +3; fast-casting +1; distant target +1; every two sustained effects +1; distracted +1…+3.
Mage.CastWill: Spend Willpower for an automatic success
Mage.NoArete: No magick dice: Arete or permanent Willpower is zero.
Mage.NoSpheres: The mage has no Spheres yet.
Mage.EffectLine: {n} successes — damage or healing up to {damage} levels, duration: {duration}.
Mage.ResFail: no successes — the effect fails; retry at +1 difficulty.
Mage.ResBotch: botch — the magick slips out of control.
Mage.BacklashDue: Five or more accumulated — the Storyteller may roll a backlash.
Mage.NoRotes: No rotes yet: they are simply learned effects — record the ones that work.

Tech.NoRotes: No procedures yet: these are rehearsed Effects, write down the ones that work.

Mage.QliphHint: The Qlipha of the Qlippoth the Fallen assign to this Sphere. Same rules — only the worldview differs.
Mage.NoWonders: No Wonders. Talismans, Devices and Periapts are in the “Mage Wonders” compendium.
Mage.WonderPool: The Wonder’s Arete — dice for its Effects
Mage.WonderCharge: Charge the Wonder with your Quintessence (1)
Mage.WonderEmpty: Nothing to draw — or no room on the wheel.
Mage.WonderFull: Nothing to charge with — or the Wonder is full.
Mage.CastSaveTip: Name, Spheres and kind of magick go to the list — cast it later in one click
Mage.CastResTip: Once per story, by the highest signature: 1–3 dots — 1 die, 4–5 — 2
Mage.RoteNoSpheres: “{name}”: rote Spheres not recognised or not known — pick them in the window.
Mage.RoteDiff: Difficulty with these Spheres and kind of magick, before modifiers
Mage.RoteCastHint: Cast: Spheres and kind of magick are preset. Shift — roll at once, no window
Mage.ResRule: A new signature starts at 1 dot. More dots: freebie points (new rating × 3) or from the Storyteller; never bought with experience.
Mage.ResEmpty: No signatures. Resonance is the echo of a mage’s deeds: one word and a degree from 1 to 5.
Mage.SynergyHint: Synergy — a tie to an outside force: Dynamic, Entropic, Static (optional rule)
Mage.ResSpent: Resonance bonus already spent this story.
Mage.ResToggle: New story: restore the bonus (or mark it spent)
Mage.ResCloakHint: Cloak the signature: Willpower, difficulty — degree + 3; each success hides a dot for about an hour
Mage.ResCloakSub: “{name}”: each success hides a dot for an hour
Mage.ResNone: Nothing to cloak: no Resonance signatures.
Mage.QuietExitHint: Leave Quiet: 1 Willpower and a turn doing nothing, Willpower roll — three successes at difficulty 7. Success: sane for the scene and −1 Paradox
Mage.QuietGoblin: {name} sinks deeper: Quiet spawns a hobgoblin — a self-willed hallucination with the mage’s Traits. It lasts {n} day(s).
Mage.QuietStay: {name} cannot break out of Quiet. Willpower spent.
Mage.QuietClear: {name} holds on to sanity for the scene. Paradox −1 (now {now}).
Mage.FlawNameHint: irony on the mage’s magick: sparks from the eyes, a lagging shadow…
Mage.FlawRule: Grade follows the backlash successes. New Paradox worsens an existing Flaw.
Mage.BackInsulate: Marauder: Quiet deflects up to {n} backlash points onto those nearby.
Mage.SeekingHint: Seeking: record the outcome — without it an Arete dot cannot be bought with experience
Mage.SeekingDone: Seeking passed — an Arete dot may be bought
Mage.SeekingRule: A Seeking is the Avatar’s trial before Arete {n}: a dream-realm, an obstacle, tests, a choice. No Paradox, hardly any rolls.
Mage.SeekingSteps: Acceptance — Epiphany: +1 Willpower and the right to an Arete dot. Denial — a painful return: −1 Willpower, no growth.
Mage.SeekingAccepted: {name} passes the Seeking: Epiphany. Willpower +1, Arete {n} unlocked.
Mage.SeekingDenied: {name} backs away from the Avatar: the Seeking fails. Willpower −1.
Mage.StepTip: Step sideways: Spirit 3, extended Arete roll against the local Gauntlet
Mage.StepLead: Where does the mage cross the Gauntlet? Difficulty on the right; the successes needed may take several rolls. Stepping sideways is vulgar.
Mage.StepBotch: Botch: the mage is stuck between worlds and needs help.
Mage.StepDone: {name} passes the Gauntlet into the Penumbra.
Mage.StepOnward: {got} of {need}: the crossing continues with the next roll.
Mage.CounterTip: Countermagick: Arete, difficulty 7 — each success cancels a success of the Effect
Mage.CounterLead: A full action; needs at least one dot in one of the Effect's Spheres. Pool and difficulty on the right.

CounterHint.basic: no cost; a success cancels an attacker's success
CounterHint.reflect: Prime 1 and 1 Quintessence; difficulty +2, extra successes rebound
CounterHint.unweave: Prime 1 and a dot in each Sphere; difficulty +1, beat all its successes
CounterHint.anti: pool is Prime, difficulty 8; a success: +1 difficulty to the Effect and 1 Quintessence

Mage.CounterFail: No successes: the Effect goes through.

CounterRes.reflect: Cancelled: {n}; anything beyond the Effect's successes rebounds on the caster.
CounterRes.unweave: Unwoven: {n} — all the Effect's successes must be beaten.

Mage.CertamenTip: Certámen: strike the rival's Aegis with your Gladius — successes drain Quintessence from their Locus
Mage.CertamenLead: Choose your Gladius Sphere. Difficulty is the rival's Aegis + 3. A targeted rival supplies their highest Sphere.
Mage.CertamenSoak: The defender may soak with a Prime roll, difficulty 6.
Mage.SpiritRule: Minor spirits come on a backlash of 11+ successes, self-aware ones on 16+. They are immune to Spirit magick below rank five unless it deals damage.
Mage.SpiritCame: A Paradox spirit comes for {name} — {spirit} ({stats}). The spirit's sheet has been created.
Mage.RealmRule: A Realm is a pocket prison. There is always a way out, and it is found without magick.
Mage.RealmCame: {name} vanishes into a Paradox Realm ({sphere}): {style}. There is a way out — but magick won't open it.

Invest.Title: Infernal Investments
Invest.hellfireSub: aggravated fire: {n}; the target soaks at difficulty 9
Invest.hellfireHit: {name} hits with Hellfire: {n} aggravated damage. The target soaks at difficulty 9.
Invest.regenDone: {name} closes a wound by the Patron's power: −1 Willpower, healed ({type}). Does not heal wounds from Prime or True Faith.
Invest.inhuman: Inhuman Attributes: raise an Attribute (each 3 points — one dot, up to 8)
Invest.inhumanDone: All dots of this Investment are already placed ({n}).
Invest.keySub: 1 success — an ordinary lock, 3 or more — a complex one; does not work on electronics
Invest.sight: Shameful Sight: Perception + Occult against the target’s Willpower (target someone)
Invest.sightSub: difficulty — Willpower of {name}; 1–2 successes — tormenting thoughts, 5 — deeply hidden ones
Invest.searchSub: the clue on the palm is exact but obscure; harder if its language is foreign

Craft.Title: Crafting a Wonder
Craft.Hint: Craft a Wonder: Sphere check, Quintessence cost, crafting rolls
Craft.Cost: Quintessence needed: {n} (5 per dot); on the wheel — {have}.

Craft.RollSub: Arete; difficulty — highest Sphere + 3; 1 Quintessence spent

Mage.RoteBookHint: start typing a name — {n} rotes in the reference
Mage.WeekNode: {name}: the Node gave free Quintessence +{free}, Tass +{tass}

Ghoul.Title: Ghoul
Ghoul.ToggleHint: The mage drinks vampire blood: vitae in the body, a blood bond, Potence 1 and Disciplines from the domitor
Ghoul.VitaeHint: vampire blood in the body; without a drink once a month the ghoul stops being one
Ghoul.BondHint: Three drinks on three separate nights — a full bond
Ghoul.HealHint: 1 vitae — one bashing or lethal health level
Ghoul.Made: {name} drinks the blood of {domitor} and becomes a ghoul: Potence 1, vitae in the body.
Ghoul.Freed: {name} is a ghoul no more: the blood of {domitor} has left the body.
Ghoul.Healed: {name} heals a wound with blood ({type}). Vitae left: {n}.

Pact.Rule: A pact level grants as many points for Investments. They cannot be spent on Arete or Spheres. Optional rule from Book of the Fallen.

Arm.Title: Wonder in combat
Arm.Hint: Into combat: make the Wonder a weapon or armor on the sheet
Arm.Off: Remove this Wonder’s weapon or armor from the sheet
Arm.Rule: Numbers come from the Wonder’s description. From then on it works as an ordinary weapon or armor; it goes away with the Wonder.

Mage.GoblinNote: A self-willed hallucination of {name}: the mage’s Traits and health. Lasts {n} day(s) (one per Arete dot).
Mage.MindIn: {name} withdraws into a mindscape for {n} day(s); on leaving, Paradox is purged (except permanent).
Mage.MindShortenSub: Wits + Enigmas, difficulty {d}; each success — a day less
Mage.MindOut: {name} leaves the mindscape: Paradox purged ({n} permanent left), the Quiet recedes.
Mage.MindOffer: Withdraw into a mindscape: a day per Paradox point (now {n}); Paradox is purged on leaving.
Mage.MindEnterHint: Enter: Perception + Meditation, difficulty — Quiet level + 3
Mage.MindLeft: The mage is in a mindscape: {n} day(s) left.
Mage.MindReady: The mindscape’s time is up — the mage may leave.
Mage.MindShortenHint: Get out sooner: Wits + Enigmas, difficulty — Quiet level + 3; each success — a day less
Mage.MindExitHint: Leave the mindscape: Paradox purged (except permanent), the Quiet removed
Mage.RealmDrifted: The Realm has drifted into the Deep Umbra — no escape on one's own, only rescue.
Mage.RealmOutHint: Escaped: penance and a problem solved without magick (Storyteller's call)
Mage.RealmDriftHint: The Realm drifts into the Deep Umbra (or clear the mark)
Mage.RealmCastWarn: The mage is in a Paradox Realm ({sphere}): magick here backfires, especially the Sphere that sent them here. The Storyteller decides the result.
Mage.RealmLong: {name}: long imprisonment in the Paradox Realm breaks their will — permanent Willpower is now {n}.
Mage.RealmDrift: {name}'s Paradox Realm drifts into the Deep Umbra: no escape on their own now.

MageCr.NeedAffinityDot: The affinity Sphere needs at least one dot.
MageCr.NotFaction: Not on the faction's affinity list
MageCr.FocusHint: Add instruments and Resonance on the sheet, on the Spheres tab.
MageCr.StartHint: Arete 1 (raised with freebies, up to 3), Willpower 5, Quintessence equal to the Avatar rating.
MageCr.AreteHere: caps the Spheres; a dot costs 4 freebies (up to 3). Freebies left: {n}

Wonder.CostHint: Wonder Background cost in points, per the book
Wonder.AreteHint: The Wonder’s own Arete — dice for its Effects (Talismans and Devices)
Wonder.QuintHint: The Wonder’s Quintessence store: a Periapt holds 5 per dot
Wonder.ParadoxHint: Permanent Paradox while the Wonder is carried (if it cannot be switched off)
Wonder.SpheresHint: Spheres built in — they set the Effect’s difficulty. Empty — pick the rank in the window.

Sorcerer.title: Sorcerer
Sorcerer.hint: Linear magic: a Path roll costs 1 Willpower — casting Attribute + Path Ability, difficulty Path level + 4. A Path cannot exceed its Ability. No Paradox.
Sorcerer.AttrHint: The Attribute the sorcerer casts with; Affiliations have favoured ones
Sorcerer.NoPaths: At least one Path is needed first.
Sorcerer.AbilityHint: Path Ability: part of the pool and the cap on the Path rating
Sorcerer.PathNote: Path roll: Path level + 4. One success per rank of each Aspect plus one for the spell.
Sorcerer.RitualTooHigh: A ritual cannot exceed the Path rating ({n}).
Sorcerer.PsychicNote: Activation: pool is Willpower, difficulty phenomenon level + 3; one success is usually enough.
Sorcerer.ConsorHint: A mage's companion: Willpower 3, Backgrounds 5 (at least a dot in Mentor), 21 freebies for a consor and 15 for an acolyte; no magic of their own.
Sorcerer.RitualXp: Pay with experience (cost — the ritual’s level)

SorcCr.Mixed: At creation a sorcerer takes either Paths or psychic phenomena — not both.
SorcCr.Hint: Sorcerer: 5 dots of Numina on the “Numina” step (Paths or phenomena), a dot for freebies costs 7, Willpower 5. Rituals — one per Path dot — are recorded on the sheet.

Golconda.SeekHint: Golconda: seeking the teaching — once a week Intelligence + Investigation, difficulty 9, no Willpower success; 4 successes within three months (Black Hand)
Golconda.NotEligible: Golconda is open only on the Path of Humanity 7+ with Conscience 4+.
Golconda.OncePerWeek: The teaching can be sought once per chronicle week.
Golconda.Found: {name} finds the teaching: the rite of Suspire. It remains to undergo it — the Storyteller decides the outcome.
Golconda.Restart: {name}: three months of seeking brought no teaching ({n} successes) — start over.
Golconda.SuspireHint: Suspire (Storyteller): a journey into the depths of the soul — passed or not. There is no second chance.
Golconda.SuspireWait: The teaching is found — the Storyteller conducts the rite of Suspire.
Golconda.SuspireRule: The rite of Suspire is a journey into the dream world, the depths of one’s soul. The Storyteller decides the outcome; there is no second chance.
Golconda.AttainedMsg: {name} attains Golconda: the Beast no longer rules, blood is spent once a week, any Trait may reach 10.
Golconda.FailedMsg: {name} does not pass the Suspire. There is no second chance.
Golconda.NoFrenzy: {name} is in Golconda: frenzy has no hold.
Golconda.NoRotschreck: {name} is in Golconda: Rötschreck has no hold.
Golconda.ActiveHint: Golconda: immune to frenzy and Rötschreck, blood once a week, Traits up to 10. Lost if Humanity drops below 7 or Conscience below 4.
Golconda.LostHint: Humanity below 7 or Conscience below 4: Golconda’s effects are lost.
Golconda.LostMsg: {name} loses Golconda: the Beast returns, Traits above {n} fall back to the generation limit.
Golconda.FailedHint: Suspire failed — there is no second chance.

Train.SpontDone: {name} вырывает у Подземного мира «{what}» {n} — прямо в сцене

Train.GuildStatus: Статус в Гильдии для этого Арканоса: {n}
Train.GuildNoStatus: Статуса в Гильдии этого Арканоса нет — учиться в ней нельзя
Train.ExchangeRule: Arcanoi exchange: a day per dot, the student spends Willpower; the teacher's successes lower the cost (not below 1). Doesn't stack with the Guild discount.
Train.ExchangeGot: Учитель {name} справился: цена «{what}» ниже на {n} (не меньше 1 опыта)

Train.Head: Between stories: training
Train.Lead: Put a trait into training with the cap button in its row. Note the mentor — when done, the dot is bought with experience as usual and the mentor goes to the log.
Train.NoteAny: Whether a teacher is needed and how long it takes is up to the Storyteller (system rule).
Train.NoteLore: A one-dot mentor will do for a novice; later you need someone who knows more; payment is a favor, a task, a relic. At the end of a story the teacher’s dice may be rolled (Demon: The Fallen).
Train.NoteMage: A mentor of a different focus may multiply the time or make training impossible; one of the same secret society teaches like a fellow (M20).
Train.TeacherRule: At the end of a story the Storyteller rolls the teacher’s Lore. Successes are experience for this Lore only, no more than the teacher’s Lore (Demon: The Fallen, optional rule).
Train.DiffHouse: a Lore of their House or a common one
Train.TeacherGot: {name}: the teacher grants {n} xp — for “{what}” only.

Craft.Head: Chimerical crafting
Craft.Name: What we make
Craft.ModHint: −1…−3 planning and research; −2 workshop or dream realm; −1 freehold or Near Dreaming, low place Banality, a similar project before; +1 average place Banality or unsuitable tools; +2 broken tools; +3 no tools, extreme Banality or a new project without a plan.
Craft.WorkHint: A week of work: Dexterity + Crafts (+ helpers); a botch loses successes equal to Banality
Craft.PlanHint: A day of planning: Intelligence + Crafts (6); every 5 successes — work difficulty −1
Craft.None: No projects. A chimerical item is made from Dreaming materials: one roll per week of work, up to the success threshold.
Craft.Done: {name} is finished — a thing of the Dreaming is made.
Craft.Botch: {name}: botch — tools or materials ruined, the work lost {n} succ.

Reave.Title: Reaving
Reave.Sub: Banality dice at the balefire of “{name}”, difficulty 7
Reave.Hint: Reaving: tear Glamour from a balefire without leave — Banality dice (7); every 2 successes beyond the rating — the freehold loses a rank. Outlawed nearly everywhere.
Reave.Msg: {name} reaves the balefire of “{fh}”: +{n} Glamour; the freehold loses ranks: {lost}.

Chimera.Head: Chimerical companions
Chimera.Name: Name
Chimera.PtsHint: Chimera points: spent / Chimera Background budget (1 — 20, 2 — 25, 3 — 30, 4 — 40, 5 — 60).
Chimera.ActorHint: A creature sheet for combat (Attributes, Abilities, Willpower; Glamour, health and Redes in the notes)
Chimera.None: No chimera. A chimerical companion comes from the Chimera Background: points for Attributes, Abilities, Glamour, Willpower, health and Redes.
Chimera.Tally: Chimera points: {n} of {b} (Attributes {a}, Abilities {s}, Glamour {g}, Willpower {w}, health {h}, Redes {r})
Chimera.Rule: C20, ch. 8: Attributes and Abilities — 3 dots per point, no free first dot; Glamour — 1 point a dot; Willpower — base 1, 3 points a dot; health — 2 levels a point (max Stamina × 5); Redes — by cost, variable ones your own.

Quest.Title: Quest outcome
Quest.Hint: A great Quest: the only way to shed a point of Banality rating; failure or retreat — +1.
Quest.Ask: The oath-bound Quest is over. How did it end?
Quest.Done: {name} completes a great Quest: Banality rating {n}.

MistsT.Title: The Mists
MistsT.Duration: A changeling slain chimerically with this Banality forgets their nature for: {d}.
MistsT.Rule: The Mists (ch. 6): the lower the Banality, the more a mortal remembers of the wonder, and the more dreamlike. A single point of Glamour helps a changeling awaken.

Text.0: remembers how Glamour works, for years
Text.3: knows something happened, but not what
Text.5: scraps of sensation without context — blamed on food or sleep
Text.7: more a dream than a memory
Text.8: explains evidence away as psychosomatic or a prank

Changeling.DrossHint: Dross: solid Glamour — a stone, a feather, a petal; 1 dross = 1 Glamour. Spent instead of Glamour when the pool is empty.

Treasure.Head: Treasures
Treasure.Name: Name
Treasure.Rule: A Treasure holds the power of an Art — no Realms needed; the Treasure Background is a dot per Art level. Its own Glamour store (usually up to 10) is spent before the owner's pool.
Treasure.None: No Treasures. A Treasure is an artifact of the Dreaming holding an Art (Treasure Background).
Treasure.Sub: {art} {n}: Glamour or Intelligence + Gremayre, difficulty 8 (system rule)
Treasure.UseHint: Awaken: a Glamour roll (Shift — Intelligence + Gremayre), difficulty 8 — system rule; a wyrd level costs 1 Glamour from the Treasure's store
Treasure.StoreHint: Invest a Glamour point from your pool
Treasure.DestroyAsk: Destroy “{name}”? It releases {n} Glamour, but it is a Banality trigger.
Treasure.Destroyed: {name} destroys the Treasure “{t}”: +{n} Glamour. This is a Banality trigger.

TH.size: 0 — a faerie ring; 1 — an apartment; 2 — a house; 3 — a mansion; 4 — a manor, a fortress; 5 — a countryside or a city.
TH.sanctuary: Defense dice for freeholders inside; the same number of dice is subtracted from Reaving and attempts to break in.
TH.resources: Money, chimerical plants, stone, creatures — what the freehold yields.
TH.passages: One rath or trod is free; each extra one — 1 trait point.

Freehold.Cost: Book of Freeholds: traits and Powers cost {pts} pts — Holdings needed {n} (3 points per dot; shared by the freeholders).
Freehold.Title: Freehold
Freehold.Name: Name
Freehold.RatingHint: Inside, the owner gains +{n} dice to defensive rolls; the Mandate: rule-breakers suffer −{n} to pools; cantrips inside are −1 difficulty.
Freehold.Rules: Freehold (C20, ch. 7): the owner swears to protect it and invests Glamour equal to its rating; Harvest — only with the owner's leave; Hospitality — food and a night's rest to anyone who asks. More than a week without leaving risks Bedlam.
Freehold.SanctuaryHint: Sanctuary: the motley's changelings sleeping by the balefire share the freehold's rating in Glamour equally, each at least 1 and no more than their rating. Requires restful sleep.

Changeling.ChimHint: Chimerical damage: only to the fae self; heals faster, twice as fast in a freehold. More lethal and aggravated than levels — chimerical death.
Changeling.ChimDeath: {name}: chimerical death — the changeling falls unconscious and wakes in the Mists (duration by Banality, a point of Glamour restores it). Banality pool +{n}.
Changeling.ColdIronHint: Cold iron: aggravated damage to both tracks at once and −1 Glamour per level. Only wrought iron.
Changeling.ColdIronHit: {name}: cold iron — {n} aggravated to body and mien, Glamour −{n}.
Changeling.ThresholdHint: Favored way to gain Glamour: Musing (Reverie) or Ravaging
Changeling.AntithesisHint: Personal Banality trigger: an act the changeling sees as the embodiment of Banality
Changeling.BanalityHint: Banality: rating 1–10; at 10 the changeling is Undone. Rating dots go away only through a great Quest.
Changeling.BanalityPoolHint: Banality pool: past 10 the rating rises; a pool above the Glamour rating brings the Mists
Changeling.NightmareHint: Nightmare 0–10: that many dice of Glamour and cantrip rolls are Nightmare dice, each 10 on them is +1 Nightmare; a botched cantrip is +1. At 10 — Imbalance.
Changeling.ImbalanceHint: Marked Willpower boxes: spending such Willpower brings a Bedlam Threshold; all Willpower Imbalanced — Bedlam. Healed by an Epiphany.
Changeling.GainGlamour: A point of Glamour (Epiphany, kith Revelry, etc.)
Changeling.TriggerHint: Banality trigger: Glamour roll, difficulty 8; failure — +1 to the Banality pool, botch — 1 per each 1
Changeling.TriggerBotch: The Banality pool grows by the number of ones.

Mod.title: Target of higher Title, unwilling
Mod.enchanted: On an enchanted mortal or kinain

Changeling.CantripRule: Glamour and Nightmare. Cantrip: Art + Realm, diff. 8; Nightmare dice — {nm}, each 10 on them is +1 Nightmare.

CW.WyrdFree: Call upon the Wyrd: cantrips are Wyrd without Glamour.
CW.Fixed: The cantrip sets its own kind.
CW.PickRealm: Choose a primary Realm for the target

Changeling.LevelTooHigh: This level is above the Art ({n})
Changeling.NeedRealm: At least one primary Realm is needed: Actor, Fae, Nature or Prop
Changeling.AffinityHint: Kith affinity: cantrips with this Realm are 1 easier
Changeling.CantripOk: The cantrip works: {n} successes — strength and duration per the Art.
Changeling.CantripBotch: Botch: the cantrip goes wrong, +1 Nightmare.
Changeling.UnleashHint: Unleashing: 2 Glamour and +1 Nightmare, Glamour + Nightmare dice, difficulty 7 — no Realms, the intent in one phrase
Changeling.UnleashOk: Controlled Unleashing: the Wyrd for turns equal to Glamour, fae mien visible; the player describes the effect.
Changeling.UnleashWild: The Unleashing runs wild: the intent is fulfilled twisted, +1 Nightmare, Wyrd until scene's end; the Storyteller describes the effect.
Changeling.UnleashFail: The Unleashing fails: Banality trigger, the Art is unusable for the scene.
Changeling.UnleashBotch: The Dreaming floods in: Imbalance, a turn of chaos, then Banality cuts it off — no Glamour or Arts until scene's end.
Changeling.ImbalanceGained: {name}: Nightmare reached 10 — Imbalance (Willpower boxes marked: {n}), Nightmare cleared, +1 Glamour.
Changeling.BedlamLost: {name}: all Willpower is Imbalanced — the changeling is lost to Bedlam.
Changeling.WyrdHint: Call upon the Wyrd: 1 Glamour and 1 Willpower. For the scene chimera become solid, tens reroll, cantrips are Wyrd without Glamour. Press again to end.
Changeling.WyrdOn: {name} invokes the Wyrd: until the end of the scene the mien and personal chimera are solid, 10s are rerolled, cantrips are wyrd at no Glamour.
Changeling.WyrdFail: {name}: the Wyrd did not answer — Banality +{n}.
Changeling.AutumnHint: Call upon Autumn: 1 Willpower — a chimerical effect doesn't touch the changeling for one action (vs poisons and Bedlam — for the scene). Banality trigger.
Changeling.AutumnOn: {name} invokes the Autumn (Willpower −1): the chimerical cannot touch them for one action. This is a Banality trigger.
Changeling.PlacePrompt: Banality of the scene's place (0 — not a banal place)
Changeling.PlaceHint: Banality of the place: cantrips here at +1 difficulty; a scene beyond Glamour rating — +1 Banality pool (Storyteller decides).
Changeling.LeashBlock: Threshold “Remove the Leash”: no cantrips — only Unleashing.
Changeling.BedlamPrompt: {name} spends imbalanced Willpower ({k}) — the Storyteller picks a Bedlam Threshold for {n} scene(s):

BedlamText.unstable: Nearby chimera warp and turn hostile (personal chimera are immune, but strange).
BedlamText.leash: No cantrips — only Unleashing the Arts.
BedlamText.self: Immediately Invoke the Wyrd and +2 Nightmare; the changeling exaggerates their nature until the Imbalance ends.
BedlamText.drowning: Immediately full Glamour; the character acts as a freehold for others' Glamour; each Glamour spent — +1 Nightmare.

Epi.Title: Epiphany
Epi.Hint: Five Paths to Epiphany: Reverie, Rapture, Ravaging, Revelry, Rhapsody — gain Glamour, heal an Imbalance or trade Glamour against Banality.
Epi.HealImbalance: Heal an Imbalance instead of Glamour
Epi.Shed: Trade gained Glamour to shed Banality

PathHint.reverie: inspire a mortal: Perception + Kenning (8) for the time needed, then Manipulation + Ability (6); 5+ following your Threshold — +1 Glamour rating.
PathHint.rapture: inspire yourself: time as for Reverie, then Attribute + Ability, difficulty (Banality − Glamour) + 6; 5+ — +1 rating and a full pool; botch — +1 Banality.
PathHint.ravaging: tear Glamour away: Banality dice (6); failure — +1 Banality, botch — +1 Banality rating; 5+ with a Threshold — +1 Glamour rating.
PathHint.revelry: the kith's way — once per story, at least a scene: the whole Glamour pool is restored.
PathHint.rhapsody: forbidden: invest 1–5 Glamour in an artist, Manipulation + Expression (7) + invested dice; the masterpiece holds 2 Glamour per success.

Epi.TimeNone: {name}: could not read the dreamer — another week of study.
Epi.Healed: {name}: Epiphany ({path}) heals 1 Imbalance instead of Glamour.
Epi.Block: {name}: botch — the dreamer gets a creative block, start over.
Epi.RaptureBotch: {name}: Rapture botched — confidence lost, Banality +1; try again no sooner than a week.
Epi.RavageFail: {name}: the Ravaging fails — no Glamour, Banality +1.
Epi.RevelryAgain: Revelry was already used this story (once per story). Do it anyway?
Epi.RhapsodyWarn: Rhapsody is forbidden even by the Unseelie.
Epi.RhapsodyOk: The masterpiece holds {n} Glamour — released only when it is destroyed; the artist is burnt out forever.
Epi.RhapsodyFail: The artist did not finish and cannot create for {n} month(s).
Epi.RhapsodyBotch: The creator is broken: +1 Banality rating per 1, no Glamour.

Oath.Head: Oaths
Oath.Title: Oath
Oath.TextPh: In your words: essence, conditions, the price of breaking it
Oath.None: No oaths. An oath is a promise sealed with Glamour: at least 1 Glamour, exact words, the penalty spoken in the oath itself.
Oath.Rule: An oath is sealed with Glamour; breaking it is a grave crime among the kithain and always a Banality trigger (ch. 6).
Oath.Broken: {name} breaks the {oath}: {fx} This is a Banality trigger.

Take.fealty: 1 Willpower; −2 difficulty to resist mental domination
Take.escheat: the liege pays Glamour; the vassal keeps the coin, +1 Willpower a week
Take.trueHearts: 1 Glamour; the faithful gain +1 Glamour from the lovers' Rapture
Take.longRoad: +1 Willpower and +1 Glamour; needs a witness
Take.crossedBlades: a Willpower point becomes a Glamour point; −2 difficulty against the foe

Break.guardianship: never two nights in the same bed for 100 years
Break.trueHearts: +1 Banality to all involved, the bird shows to all
Break.longRoad: −3 Glamour and −3 Willpower (outright refusal — all Glamour, −1 permanent Willpower, +2 Banality)
Break.crossedBlades: −1 permanent Willpower, scars on the face
Break.custom: the price is in the wording

Changeling.Undone: {name}: Banality 10 — Undone, the changeling is fae no longer.

Artifact.Title: Thaumaturge's Workshop
Artifact.SectionHint: The talisman and items made with Thaumaturgy rituals. A talisman held in hand adds dice to the primary path and rituals by itself.
Artifact.OpenHint: Craft an item with a ritual, enchant a talisman
Artifact.UseHint: Spend a charge (if any) and show the item in chat
Artifact.HeldHint: Talisman in hand: dice to its maker's magic, +1 difficulty to magic against them
Artifact.MakerIdHint: The maker: the talisman works only for them, and gives others +3 dice to magic against them
Artifact.Unknown: The character does not know this ritual.
Artifact.UnknownGM: The character does not know the ritual — the Storyteller may allow it.
Artifact.Name: Name
Artifact.Secret: A secret of the House: almost no one knows this ritual.
Artifact.CraftBotch: {name}: the ritual “{item}” went wrong — the Storyteller decides what the botch brings.
Artifact.CraftFailed: {name}: the ritual “{item}” failed, the item is not enchanted.

Talisman.Title: Enchant Talisman
Talisman.Side: A personal “wizard's staff”: a month of work, week by week. Progress also shows on the sheet.
Talisman.Lead: A rigid object at least a meter long. A full lunar month ({nights} nights), 6 hours a night, 1 blood per night. Once a week — Intelligence + Occult, diff. {diff}; {need} successes are needed over 4 weeks, or the talisman is ruined.
Talisman.AbandonAsk: Abandon the talisman? The nights spent are lost.
Talisman.Auto: The system applies it: +2 dice to the primary path and +1 to rituals while the talisman is in hand; +1 to attack if it is a weapon; +1 difficulty to magic against the holder when they are the target; +3 dice to whoever holds someone else's talisman and casts at its maker.
Talisman.HaveOne: The character already has a talisman: {item}. A thaumaturge has only one.
Talisman.Busy: Work on a talisman is already under way.
Talisman.OnlyOne: A thaumaturge has only one talisman.
Talisman.NoBlood: A week of work needs {n} blood (1 per night).
Talisman.WeekNote: Week {n} of 4 · successes {hits}/{need} · 7 blood per week
Talisman.Started: {name} begins enchanting {item}: a lunar month, {need} successes needed.
Talisman.Ruined: {item}: the work broke down — the talisman is ruined, start again at the new moon.
Talisman.Short: {item}: the month is over, but only {hits} of {need} successes — the talisman is ruined.
Talisman.Done: {name} completes the talisman {item}. Mark it “in hand” with the button on the sheet.
Talisman.DonePhyl: {name} binds part of the soul into {item}: −1 permanent Willpower, the phylactery is ready.

Find.Side: A random find for the Storyteller: the item, its maker, chantry, era, sigils, a mark and a story hook.
Find.NoTarget: No one to give it to: open the workshop from a sheet or select a token.
Find.TalismanForeign: The maker is not necessarily dead: if alive, set them in “Whose talisman” — the holder then gets +3 dice to magic against them.

Ritae.Title: Sabbat Ritae
Ritae.LeapNote: Whoever clears it — Courage +1 for 3 nights (may exceed 5); stunts are harder
